api-gateway.title: Gateway returns errors for payroll export requests
api-gateway.description: Users could not start payroll exports because the api-gateway returned errors before forwarding requests. Support reports and a rise in gateway error rates exposed the problem.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A gateway deployment introduced an incompatible route handler for export requests. Rolling back the deployment restored the route.

api-gateway.title: Employee profile updates are rejected as oversized
api-gateway.description: Users updating employee profiles with attachments saw request-size errors even for modest files. An increase in rejected requests alerted the gateway team.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A configuration change lowered the api-gateway body-size limit below the documented upload limit. Restoring the correct limit allowed the requests through.

api-gateway.title: Clients cannot establish secure connections to the gateway
api-gateway.description: API clients failed to connect and reported certificate validation errors. Certificate monitoring and customer reports identified the interruption.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The api-gateway's TLS certificate had expired after its renewal job failed. The team installed a renewed certificate and repaired the renewal job.

api-gateway.title: Gateway rejects valid sessions during identity service outage
api-gateway.description: Users with valid sessions received authentication errors across the platform. Gateway authentication alerts coincided with failures from the identity service.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The identity service was unavailable, preventing the api-gateway from validating session tokens. Restoring the dependency allowed authentication to resume.

api-gateway.title: Gateway latency rises during a surge in clock-in requests
api-gateway.description: Workers experienced delays submitting clock-ins, and some requests timed out. Traffic and latency alerts showed that the api-gateway had exhausted its available connections.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A shift-change traffic surge exceeded the gateway's connection capacity. Increasing capacity and tuning connection limits restored normal response times.

api-gateway.title: Gateway instances restart repeatedly while processing large responses
api-gateway.description: Clients saw intermittent connection resets when retrieving large employee lists. Restart alerts and memory graphs revealed repeated api-gateway crashes.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A response buffering change caused gateway memory use to grow with payload size. Disabling full-response buffering and deploying a fix stopped the restarts.

api-gateway.title: Tenant routing lookup delays API requests
api-gateway.description: Requests for several large tenants took much longer than usual to reach backend services. Gateway latency alerts and query tracing identified delays in tenant routing lookups.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A routing metadata query was scanning the full tenant table after an index was removed. Rebuilding the index restored lookup performance.

api-gateway.title: Requests for one tenant are routed to the wrong backend
api-gateway.description: Users for one tenant received errors when opening workforce schedules. Gateway logs and support reports showed that their requests were being sent to an unrelated backend.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A corrupted tenant routing record pointed the api-gateway to the wrong destination. The team corrected the record and invalidated the gateway's routing cache.

api-gateway.title: Gateway cannot resolve the scheduling service
api-gateway.description: Schedule requests failed while other API operations continued to work. Gateway upstream error alerts showed repeated failures to resolve the scheduling service name.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record prevented the api-gateway from finding the scheduling service. Correcting the record and clearing cached failures restored routing.

api-gateway.title: Gateway cannot load signing keys after permission change
api-gateway.description: Users were unable to authenticate new API sessions. Gateway startup and authentication alerts showed failures when loading token verification keys.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the api-gateway's access to its key store. Restoring the required read permission allowed token verification to resume.

api-gateway.title: Gateway fails to validate tokens after identity provider key change
api-gateway.description: Some users were rejected immediately after signing in. Authentication error alerts showed that the api-gateway could not match their tokens to a known signing key.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The identity provider changed the format of its published key metadata, which the gateway parser did not support. Updating the parser and refreshing the key cache restored validation.

api-gateway.title: Gateway rate limits remain active after usage window ends
api-gateway.description: API clients continued to receive rate-limit errors after their usage should have reset. Customer reports and rate-limit metrics revealed the stale counters.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A scheduled cleanup job for gateway rate-limit counters had stopped running. Restarting the job and clearing expired counters restored access.

api-gateway.title: Gateway blocks legitimate time-off requests
api-gateway.description: Employees submitting time-off requests received access-denied responses. Support reports and firewall logs showed that the api-gateway was blocking requests containing ordinary comments.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: An overly broad request-filtering rule treated common comment text as malicious input. Narrowing the rule stopped the false positives.

api-gateway.title: Gateway drops authorization header on redirected requests
api-gateway.description: API clients following redirects received unauthorized responses when accessing employee records. Request traces showed that the api-gateway removed the authorization header before forwarding the redirected request.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A redirect-handling change stripped headers that should have been preserved for trusted upstreams. Correcting the header policy restored access.

api-gateway.title: Gateway retries create duplicate shift assignments
api-gateway.description: Some managers saw duplicate shift assignments after requests appeared to time out. Support reports and gateway traces showed that the same request had reached the scheduling service twice.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The api-gateway retried non-idempotent requests after ambiguous upstream timeouts. Disabling those retries prevented duplicate submissions.

api-gateway.title: Browser clients cannot call the gateway from the workforce portal
api-gateway.description: Users could load the workforce portal but could not retrieve their schedules in the browser. Browser error reports and gateway response headers pointed to a cross-origin policy failure.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A gateway configuration update omitted the portal's allowed origin. Restoring the origin in the cross-origin policy fixed browser requests.

api-gateway.title: Gateway returns stale employee directory responses
api-gateway.description: Users continued to see outdated employee directory entries after changes were saved. Support reports and comparisons with backend responses identified stale gateway cache entries.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The api-gateway cache did not invalidate directory responses after updates. Fixing invalidation and clearing affected entries restored current results.

api-gateway.title: Gateway rejects requests with valid encoded characters in paths
api-gateway.description: Clients could not retrieve records whose identifiers contained encoded spaces. A rise in not-found responses and request traces exposed inconsistent path handling.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The api-gateway decoded request paths twice before routing them. Removing the second decoding step allowed valid paths to reach the correct handlers.

api-gateway.title: Gateway health checks remove healthy payroll backends
api-gateway.description: Payroll API requests intermittently returned service-unavailable errors even though backend instances were healthy. Gateway health-check metrics showed that all payroll targets had been marked unavailable.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The health-check path was changed on the payroll service but not in the api-gateway configuration. Updating the configured path restored the backend pool.

api-gateway.title: Gateway WebSocket connections close shortly after opening
api-gateway.description: Users viewing live schedule updates repeatedly lost their connections and missed changes until refreshing. Connection-duration monitoring and support reports revealed the pattern.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A gateway idle timeout was shorter than the interval between WebSocket keepalive messages. Increasing the timeout kept active connections open.

auth-service.title: Users are signed out when access tokens refresh
auth-service.description: Users were repeatedly returned to the sign-in screen during active sessions. Support reports and an increase in refresh failures revealed the problem.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A deploy changed how refresh tokens were parsed and rejected valid tokens. Rolling back the change restored session renewal.

auth-service.title: New sessions expire after only a few minutes
auth-service.description: Users had to sign in again shortly after accessing the platform. Monitoring detected a sharp increase in successful sign-ins per user.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the session lifetime in minutes instead of hours. The value was corrected and affected sessions were renewed.

auth-service.title: Single sign-on fails because the service certificate expired
auth-service.description: Employees using single sign-on could not reach their HR and payroll pages. Authentication failure alerts identified rejected certificate checks.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by auth-service for single sign-on had expired. A replacement certificate was installed and the trust configuration was updated.

auth-service.title: Sign-ins fail while the session cache is unavailable
auth-service.description: Users saw errors after submitting valid credentials and could not start new sessions. Cache availability alerts and elevated authentication errors exposed the outage.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The session cache dependency was unavailable, preventing auth-service from storing new sessions. Restoring the cache service allowed sign-ins to succeed.

auth-service.title: Authentication requests fail during peak shift changes
auth-service.description: Many employees could not sign in around shift change, while some requests waited until they timed out. Request latency and memory alerts showed auth-service instances restarting under load.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A memory leak in token validation exhausted instance memory during traffic spikes. The leak was fixed and capacity was increased to handle peak demand.

auth-service.title: Password sign-in is slow for large tenants
auth-service.description: Employees at large tenants waited unusually long after submitting their credentials. Latency alerts and support reports pointed to slow account lookups in auth-service.
auth-service.resolution_summary: An account lookup query lacked an index on the tenant and normalized username fields. Adding the index returned sign-in latency to normal.

auth-service.title: Some employees are signed in to the wrong workforce account
auth-service.description: A small group of employees reached an incorrect account after signing in and could not see their expected schedules. Support escalations revealed that the affected accounts shared identity records.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A failed data migration had attached several external identities to the wrong account records. The mappings were repaired and validation was added to the migration process.

auth-service.title: Federated sign-in fails when identity provider keys cannot be resolved
auth-service.description: Users of an external identity provider received sign-in errors even though the provider was operating normally. Auth-service logs showed repeated failures to resolve the provider's signing key endpoint.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration error prevented auth-service from resolving the endpoint. Correcting the DNS configuration restored key retrieval and token verification.

auth-service.title: Auth-service cannot issue tokens after signing permission is removed
auth-service.description: Users could submit their credentials but received an error before entering the platform. Token issuance alerts showed that signing operations were being denied.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A permission change removed auth-service access to its signing key. Restoring the required permission allowed token issuance to resume.

auth-service.title: Text message verification codes are not delivered
auth-service.description: Users relying on text message verification could not complete sign-in. Delivery failure alerts and support reports showed that requests to the messaging provider were being rejected.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed the required request format for sending messages. Auth-service was updated to use the new format, restoring code delivery.

auth-service.title: Users cannot sign in after the token signing key stops rotating
auth-service.description: New sign-ins failed for users whose clients could no longer validate issued tokens. Monitoring showed an increase in token signature validation errors.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A scheduled key rotation job had failed, leaving auth-service using a key that clients no longer trusted. The job was repaired and a new signing key was published.

auth-service.title: Legitimate users are blocked by the login rate limit
auth-service.description: Employees sharing a workplace network received too many attempts errors on their first sign-in attempt. Support reports and rate-limit metrics showed that unrelated users were being grouped together.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The rate limiter counted attempts only by network address rather than by account and address. The rule was corrected and the accumulated counters were cleared.

auth-service.title: Authenticator app codes are rejected despite being current
auth-service.description: Users entering codes from authenticator apps could not complete multifactor authentication. A rise in verification failures across multiple tenants triggered an alert.
auth-service.resolution_summary: Clock drift on auth-service instances caused valid time-based codes to fall outside the accepted window. Time synchronization was restored and instance clocks were checked.

auth-service.title: Users are repeatedly prompted to sign in after authentication succeeds
auth-service.description: Users saw a successful sign-in followed immediately by another sign-in prompt. Browser reports and session creation metrics showed that session cookies were not being returned.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A cookie domain change prevented browsers from sending the session cookie to the application. Restoring the correct cookie scope stopped the sign-in loop.

auth-service.title: A refresh token can be used twice during concurrent requests
auth-service.description: Some sessions produced duplicate token rotations when clients sent refresh requests at the same time. An automated security check detected repeated acceptance of the same refresh token.
auth-service.resolution_summary: Refresh token consumption was not atomic, allowing concurrent requests to pass the same validity check. An atomic update was added to ensure each token can be used only once.

auth-service.title: Password reset requests succeed but reset messages never arrive
auth-service.description: Users requesting password resets saw a confirmation but did not receive reset instructions. Message queue alerts and support reports showed a growing backlog of unsent reset messages.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The worker responsible for sending password reset messages had stopped consuming the queue. Restarting the worker and processing the backlog restored delivery.

auth-service.title: Single sign-on rejects users with multiple group memberships
auth-service.description: Employees belonging to several workforce groups received an authorization error after their identity provider authenticated them. Sign-in logs showed that group claims failed validation for affected users.
auth-service.resolution_summary: Auth-service expected a single group value and rejected a list of groups. The claim parser was updated to accept and validate multiple values.

auth-service.title: Users are intermittently assigned another tenant's sign-in settings
auth-service.description: Some users were directed to an unexpected sign-in method and could not access their own tenant. Support reports and configuration lookup traces exposed inconsistent results.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The sign-in settings cache used a key that was not scoped to the tenant. The cache key was corrected and existing entries were cleared.

auth-service.title: OAuth sign-in fails after users return from an identity provider
auth-service.description: Users completed authentication with their identity provider but received a state validation error on return. Auth-service logs showed an increase in rejected authorization callbacks.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A proxy change removed the header auth-service used to determine the original request scheme, causing it to generate an inconsistent callback. The proxy header configuration was corrected.

auth-service.title: Account lockouts remain after administrators unlock users
auth-service.description: Administrators unlocked affected employees, but those employees continued to receive locked account errors. Support reports showed that unlock actions completed without restoring access.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The unlock operation updated the account database but did not invalidate the cached lockout state. Cache invalidation was added and stale lockout entries were cleared.

user-service.title: New users see a blank profile after sign-in
user-service.description: Newly created users saw a blank profile page after signing in. Support reports and an increase in profile API errors revealed the problem.
user-service.resolution_summary: A deployment changed the profile response format without updating the user-service serializer. Rolling back the deployment restored profile loading.

user-service.title: Employee invitations fail for tenants with custom domains
user-service.description: Administrators could not invite employees using custom domains because user-service rejected valid addresses. The issue was detected through a rise in invitation validation errors.
user-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change applied an overly restrictive domain validation rule. Restoring the previous rule allowed invitations to be sent.

user-service.title: Single sign-on fails because the service certificate expired
user-service.description: Employees using single sign-on could not access their accounts. Authentication failure alerts and administrator reports identified the issue.
user-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by user-service to sign single sign-on requests had expired. Replacing the certificate and updating the identity provider configuration restored access.

user-service.title: User lookups fail during identity provider outage
user-service.description: Users signing in through a connected identity provider received an account lookup error. Monitoring showed that user-service could not complete requests to the provider.
user-service.resolution_summary: The identity provider was unavailable, and user-service treated the failed lookup as a fatal error. The provider recovered, and a retry limit was added to reduce repeated failures.

user-service.title: Profile updates fail when user-service runs out of memory
user-service.description: Employees intermittently received errors when saving profile changes. Restart alerts and memory usage monitoring showed that user-service instances were repeatedly exhausting available memory.
user-service.resolution_summary: An unbounded cache of profile responses consumed available memory. The cache was given a size limit and the affected instances were restarted.

user-service.title: Employee directory searches time out for large tenants
user-service.description: Administrators searching large employee directories saw long waits followed by errors. Database latency alerts and support reports showed that the problem affected searches with common names.
user-service.resolution_summary: A directory search query scanned the full user table because it lacked a suitable index. Adding the index and updating the query reduced search times.

user-service.title: Some employees appear twice in the directory
user-service.description: Administrators saw duplicate employee entries and sometimes selected the wrong account when assigning access. A customer report led to a review of user records.
user-service.resolution_summary: A failed import had created duplicate user records before its retry completed. The duplicates were merged and a uniqueness check was added to the import path.

user-service.title: User-service cannot resolve the notification service
user-service.description: Administrators could create invitations, but recipients did not receive them. Delivery monitoring showed repeated failures when user-service tried to reach the notification service.
user-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS configuration prevented user-service from resolving the notification service hostname. Correcting the DNS record allowed queued invitations to be delivered.

user-service.title: Managers cannot view profiles for their direct reports
user-service.description: Managers received permission errors when opening profiles for their direct reports. Access-denied metrics and reports from administrators exposed the problem.
user-service.resolution_summary: A role policy update removed the permission required for manager profile access. Restoring the permission fixed access without changing other role privileges.

user-service.title: Automatic user provisioning rejects department updates
user-service.description: Changes to employee departments stopped appearing in the platform for tenants using automatic provisioning. Provisioning error alerts showed that user-service was rejecting update requests.
user-service.resolution_summary: A third-party provisioning client changed the format of an optional department field. User-service was updated to accept both the old and new formats.

user-service.title: Deactivated employees remain active after the nightly sync
user-service.description: Some employees who had been deactivated in the source system could still sign in. An administrator noticed the mismatch during an access review.
user-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled deactivation sync had stopped after encountering one malformed record. The record was corrected, the sync was rerun, and per-record error handling was added.

user-service.title: Password reset links expire immediately for some users
user-service.description: Some employees received password reset links that were rejected as expired as soon as they opened them. Support reports showed that the failures were concentrated on requests handled by a subset of user-service instances.
user-service.resolution_summary: Those instances had clocks that were ahead of the token validation clock. Correcting time synchronization restored normal reset link validity.

user-service.title: Bulk user imports stall before all accounts are created
user-service.description: Administrators saw bulk imports remain in progress, with some employees missing from the directory. Queue monitoring showed that user-service import workers had stopped consuming messages.
user-service.resolution_summary: A poison message repeatedly crashed the worker before it could acknowledge the queue. The message was removed and failed messages were routed to a separate queue.

user-service.title: Users are signed out repeatedly while browsing
user-service.description: Employees were prompted to sign in again during normal use. Session validation errors increased across user-service instances and triggered an alert.
user-service.resolution_summary: Instances were using different session signing configurations after a partial rollout. Synchronizing the configuration and restarting the affected instances stopped the unexpected sign-outs.

user-service.title: Profile photos fail to upload for larger images
user-service.description: Employees could select profile photos, but larger uploads failed without saving. Support reports and request logs showed failures near the upload size limit.
user-service.resolution_summary: A proxy request limit was lower than the size advertised by user-service. Aligning the proxy limit with the supported upload size fixed the failures.

user-service.title: New role assignments do not take effect promptly
user-service.description: Administrators assigned roles successfully, but users continued to see their previous access for an extended period. An access test and cache metrics revealed that stale role entries were being served.
user-service.resolution_summary: Role changes did not invalidate cached permission data. Adding cache invalidation to the role update path made new assignments take effect promptly.

user-service.title: Account recovery requests fail after a database credential rotation
user-service.description: Users requesting account recovery received an error instead of a recovery message. Connection failures in user-service logs alerted the on-call team.
user-service.resolution_summary: Some database connections continued using an old credential after rotation. Refreshing the connection pool restored account recovery requests.

user-service.title: Employees cannot change their preferred language
user-service.description: Employees saved a new language preference but saw the previous language after refreshing the page. A support investigation reproduced the behavior through the user-service preferences endpoint.
user-service.resolution_summary: A preference update wrote the new value under an obsolete field name. Correcting the field mapping and migrating affected values restored saved preferences.

user-service.title: Invitation acceptance fails when many employees join at once
user-service.description: Employees accepting invitations during a large onboarding event intermittently received errors. Request metrics showed that user-service had exhausted its database connection pool.
user-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent invitation acceptance requests held database connections longer than necessary. Shortening the transaction and increasing the pool limit within database capacity resolved the failures.

user-service.title: User-service rejects valid single sign-on responses
user-service.description: Employees using single sign-on were returned to the login page after authenticating. Authentication logs showed that user-service was rejecting responses with an unexpected audience value.
user-service.resolution_summary: An identity configuration update changed the expected audience without updating user-service. Aligning the configured audience with the identity provider restored sign-in.

payroll-service.title: Payroll calculations omitted overtime for split shifts
payroll-service.description: Some employees with split shifts received payroll previews without overtime pay. Payroll administrators had to review affected calculations before approving pay runs. A reconciliation alert detected a difference between approved time and calculated pay.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an error when combining split-shift hours. The calculation logic was corrected and affected previews were recalculated.

payroll-service.title: Direct deposit files were rejected by the bank
payroll-service.description: Payroll administrators could not submit direct deposit files because the bank rejected their file format. Affected employees' payments were delayed while replacement files were prepared. The issue was detected through an increase in bank rejection notices.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change removed a required field from the export header. The field was restored and affected files were regenerated.

payroll-service.title: Payroll approvals failed after a certificate expired
payroll-service.description: Administrators received an error when approving pay runs, leaving the runs in a pending state. Monitoring detected repeated failures when payroll-service attempted to connect to the signing service.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used for signing requests had expired. The certificate was renewed and pending approvals were retried.

payroll-service.title: Tax calculations were unavailable during a dependency outage
payroll-service.description: Payroll previews failed when administrators requested tax withholding calculations. Pay runs requiring new calculations could not be finalized. The issue was detected by dependency health checks and user reports.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The external tax calculation provider was unavailable. Once the provider recovered, failed calculations were retried.

payroll-service.title: Large payroll exports exhausted service memory
payroll-service.description: Exports for tenants with large workforces stalled or failed before producing a file. Some other payroll requests also became slow. Memory alerts and repeated service restarts revealed the issue.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The export process loaded all employee rows into memory at once. It was changed to stream rows in batches, reducing memory use.

payroll-service.title: Pay run history pages loaded slowly
payroll-service.description: Administrators experienced long waits when opening pay run history. Some requests timed out, making it difficult to review past payroll results. Request latency alerts identified the affected endpoint.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A database query scanned the full pay run table when filtering by tenant. An index was added and the query was updated to use it.

payroll-service.title: Duplicate deductions appeared in payroll previews
payroll-service.description: Some payroll previews showed the same benefit deduction twice. Administrators paused affected pay runs to avoid underpaying employees. A comparison between deduction records and preview totals exposed the duplicates.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A retry process had inserted duplicate deduction records after an interrupted import. The duplicate records were removed and the import was made idempotent.

payroll-service.title: Payroll-service could not resolve the payment gateway
payroll-service.description: Direct deposit submissions failed before reaching the payment gateway. Administrators saw payment runs remain queued and could not confirm submission. Connection alerts showed repeated name resolution failures.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration error pointed payroll-service to an unavailable resolver. The resolver configuration was corrected and queued submissions were processed.

payroll-service.title: Payroll administrators could not download pay statements
payroll-service.description: Authorized administrators received permission errors when downloading employee pay statements. Employees could still view their statements, but administrators could not retrieve copies for review. Support reports and access logs revealed the failures.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A role policy update removed the download permission from the payroll administrator role. The permission was restored and the policy tests were expanded.

payroll-service.title: Bank account verification failed after an API change
payroll-service.description: Employees could not add or update direct deposit accounts because verification requests were rejected. New account changes remained unverified and could not be used for payment. Error monitoring detected a rise in rejected third-party requests.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The verification provider changed a required response field. The integration was updated to handle the new response format and pending verifications were retried.

payroll-service.title: Scheduled payroll reminders were not sent
payroll-service.description: Payroll administrators did not receive reminders to review upcoming pay runs. Some organizations missed their usual review window and had to check run status manually. The missing reminders were detected by a scheduled job completion alert.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The reminder job stopped after encountering an invalid tenant setting. The setting was corrected and the job was changed to isolate errors by tenant.

payroll-service.title: Finalized pay runs displayed incorrect net pay totals
payroll-service.description: Some finalized pay runs showed net pay totals that did not match their employee payment details. Administrators had difficulty reconciling the runs, although the payment amounts themselves were correct. A reconciliation check detected the mismatch.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A rounding error in the summary calculation accumulated fractional amounts incorrectly. The summary logic was corrected and affected totals were rebuilt.

payroll-service.title: Payroll previews failed for employees with new earning codes
payroll-service.description: Administrators could not generate previews for employees assigned recently created earning codes. Affected employees were left out of payroll review until the previews succeeded. Application error alerts identified failures while loading earning code definitions.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A stale cache did not receive updates when earning codes were created. Cache invalidation was fixed and the affected entries were refreshed.

payroll-service.title: Payroll-service processed termination payouts more than once
payroll-service.description: Some termination payouts appeared twice in draft pay runs after administrators retried a request. Affected drafts required manual review before approval. An alert on repeated payout references detected the duplicates.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The payout endpoint did not enforce a unique request reference. Duplicate draft entries were removed and a uniqueness check was added.

payroll-service.title: Payroll imports failed for files with accented employee names
payroll-service.description: Administrators could not import payroll adjustments from files containing certain accented characters. Adjustments in rejected files were not applied to draft pay runs. Import error logs and user reports identified the pattern.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The file parser assumed a character encoding that did not match the uploaded files. The parser was updated to handle the supported encoding and rejected files were reimported.

payroll-service.title: Payroll submission requests timed out behind a network proxy
payroll-service.description: Administrators saw submission requests time out even though some pay runs had been accepted. They had to check run status before retrying to avoid confusion. Network latency alerts and mismatched request logs exposed the problem.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A proxy timeout was shorter than the time needed to submit large pay runs. The timeout was increased and the submission response was changed to return a status for tracking.

payroll-service.title: Retroactive pay adjustments used an outdated hourly rate
payroll-service.description: Retroactive adjustments for some employees were calculated using their previous hourly rate. Payroll administrators had to correct affected drafts before finalizing them. A reconciliation report comparing rate changes with adjustments detected the errors.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The adjustment calculation selected the rate in effect when the request was created rather than the rate applicable to the work period. The rate lookup was corrected and affected adjustments were recalculated.

payroll-service.title: Payroll audit events stopped recording approval actions
payroll-service.description: Approval actions completed successfully but were missing from the payroll audit history. Administrators could not verify who had approved affected runs from the audit view. A monitoring check detected a gap between approval activity and recorded audit events.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The audit event queue had reached its storage limit after a consumer stopped processing messages. The consumer was restarted, queue capacity was restored, and retained events were replayed.

payroll-service.title: Payroll schedules shifted after a time zone setting change
payroll-service.description: Some pay runs appeared on the wrong local day after administrators changed their organization time zone. This caused confusion about when payroll review was due. Support reports and schedule comparisons identified the shift.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The schedule conversion applied the time zone offset twice. The conversion was corrected and affected upcoming schedules were rebuilt.

payroll-service.title: Payroll-service rejected valid expense reimbursements
payroll-service.description: Valid reimbursements were excluded from draft pay runs and shown as rejected. Administrators had to delay approval while affected reimbursements were reviewed. A spike in validation failures triggered an alert.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A validation rule incorrectly treated zero tax withholding on reimbursements as missing data. The rule was corrected and rejected reimbursements were reprocessed.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet submissions fail after a validation deploy
timesheet-service.description: Employees saw an error when submitting timesheets that included unpaid breaks. The failure blocked manager approval for affected entries. Support reports and a rise in submission errors revealed the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A new validation rule incorrectly required unpaid breaks to have a pay code. The deploy was rolled back and the rule was corrected.

timesheet-service.title: Managers cannot approve timesheets for their teams
timesheet-service.description: Managers received permission errors when approving timesheets for direct reports. Employees' hours remained pending and could not be sent to payroll. The issue was detected through support reports and elevated authorization failures.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A permissions mapping omitted the approval action from the manager role. Restoring the mapping allowed approvals to resume.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet pages time out for large teams
timesheet-service.description: Managers with large teams saw the timesheet list load slowly or time out. This delayed their review of employee hours. Request latency alerts identified the affected endpoint.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A database query scanned all time entries before filtering by team. Adding an index and changing the query reduced the response time.

timesheet-service.title: Employees cannot open timesheets because a service certificate expired
timesheet-service.description: Employees saw connection errors when opening timesheets. The service could not retrieve the employee details needed to display their entries. Connection failure alerts detected the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used for the employee directory connection had expired. Renewing the certificate and reloading the connection restored access.

timesheet-service.title: Clock-out entries are delayed during queue saturation
timesheet-service.description: Employees clocking out saw their shifts remain open for several minutes. Managers could not review the completed hours until processing caught up. Queue depth alerts detected the growing backlog.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The time-entry queue had too few consumers for the volume of clock events. Increasing consumer capacity drained the backlog.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet totals omit overnight shift hours
timesheet-service.description: Employees working overnight saw fewer hours on their timesheets than they had recorded. Managers noticed discrepancies while reviewing shift totals. The missing hours affected the totals prepared for payroll.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A calculation split overnight shifts at midnight but discarded the second segment. Correcting the split logic and recalculating affected totals restored the hours.

timesheet-service.title: Time entries display in the wrong local time
timesheet-service.description: Employees saw clock-in and clock-out times shifted by several hours. The displayed duration was correct, but managers could not reliably compare entries with schedules. Support reports from affected locations exposed the issue.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the default display timezone instead of using each work location's timezone. Restoring location-based timezone selection corrected the display.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet exports fail when payroll provider rejects requests
timesheet-service.description: Payroll administrators could not export approved hours from timesheet-service. Export attempts returned an error, leaving payroll batches incomplete. Export failure alerts and administrator reports identified the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The payroll provider changed a required field name in its API. Updating the export adapter to send the new field restored exports.

timesheet-service.title: Duplicate time entries appear after clock events are retried
timesheet-service.description: Some employees saw two identical entries after clocking in. The duplicates inflated timesheet totals until managers removed them. A reconciliation check detected an increase in repeated clock events.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: Retried clock events were processed without checking their idempotency keys. Adding the check and removing confirmed duplicates corrected the affected timesheets.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet service restarts while generating large reports
timesheet-service.description: Managers generating reports for large teams saw downloads fail partway through. Other timesheet requests also failed briefly during repeated service restarts. Memory alerts and restart counts revealed the issue.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: Report generation loaded all matching entries into memory at once. Streaming report rows kept memory use within the available limit.

timesheet-service.title: Approved hours remain locked after a payroll export is canceled
timesheet-service.description: Managers could not edit approved timesheets after canceling a payroll export. The locked hours prevented corrections from being included in the next export. Support reports identified the affected batches.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The cancellation path failed to release export locks on timesheets. The locks were cleared and cancellation was updated to release them.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet reminders are not sent to employees
timesheet-service.description: Employees did not receive reminders to submit incomplete timesheets. Managers had to follow up manually with their teams. A scheduled job monitoring alert showed that the reminder run had not completed.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A malformed cursor caused the reminder job to stop while paging through employees. Fixing the cursor handling and rerunning the job sent the pending reminders.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet entries cannot be saved during a database outage
timesheet-service.description: Employees received errors when saving new or edited time entries. Unsaved changes had to be entered again after service recovered. Database connection alerts detected the failure.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The database dependency became unavailable after its primary node failed to switch over. The database was restored and connection pools were refreshed.

timesheet-service.title: Managers see stale approval status after submitting decisions
timesheet-service.description: Managers approved timesheets but continued to see them marked as pending. Some repeated the approval action because the status did not change. Support reports and a comparison with stored approval records exposed the mismatch.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: An approval update did not invalidate the cached timesheet status. Cache invalidation was added and stale entries were cleared.

timesheet-service.title: Imported timesheets contain incorrect project assignments
timesheet-service.description: Employees saw time entries assigned to the wrong projects after a bulk import. Project-based reports were unreliable for the affected entries. A manager noticed discrepancies while comparing the import file with timesheets.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The import parser matched project columns by position after the template order changed. The parser was updated to match column names, and affected assignments were repaired.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet approvals fail because the employee directory cannot be resolved
timesheet-service.description: Managers received errors when approving timesheets because employee details could not be retrieved. Pending approvals accumulated while the lookup failed. Dependency health checks reported repeated name resolution failures.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the record used to reach the employee directory. Restoring the record and clearing cached lookup failures resumed approvals.

timesheet-service.title: Break deductions are applied twice to edited shifts
timesheet-service.description: Employees who edited completed shifts saw their payable hours decrease unexpectedly. Managers found that the deduction appeared twice in the timesheet calculation. A support investigation reproduced the issue with an edited shift.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: Editing a shift reapplied the automatic break deduction without removing the previous one. The calculation was corrected and affected totals were recalculated.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet attachments fail to upload
timesheet-service.description: Employees could not attach supporting documents to time entries. The entries could still be saved, but managers could not review the documents. Upload failure alerts and support reports identified the issue.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A storage policy change removed write access for timesheet-service. Restoring the required access allowed attachments to upload again.

timesheet-service.title: Overtime totals are missing from exported timesheets
timesheet-service.description: Payroll administrators saw approved hours exported without the overtime breakdown. They had to pause processing and verify affected totals before continuing. An export reconciliation check detected the missing values.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A feature flag disabled overtime classification during export while leaving it enabled in timesheet views. Correcting the flag and regenerating affected exports restored the breakdown.

timesheet-service.title: Employees cannot submit timesheets containing deleted cost centers
timesheet-service.description: Employees received a generic error when submitting timesheets with entries linked to retired cost centers. They could not tell which entries needed correction. Support reproduced the failure using an affected timesheet.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The submission check assumed every referenced cost center was active. It was changed to identify retired cost centers and prompt employees to select valid replacements.

benefits-service.title: Employees could not submit enrollments with dependents
benefits-service.description: Employees received a validation error when submitting a benefits enrollment that included a dependent. Support reports and a rise in failed enrollment requests exposed the issue.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A deploy incorrectly required an optional dependent identifier. The validation rule was corrected and affected employees were able to resubmit.

benefits-service.title: Dental plans disappeared from the enrollment catalog
benefits-service.description: Eligible employees could not see dental plans when choosing benefits. An administrator reported the missing plans after comparing the catalog with configured offerings.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change disabled the dental plan category. Restoring the category made the plans visible again.

benefits-service.title: Carrier enrollment transmissions failed certificate validation
benefits-service.description: Benefits enrollment changes were accepted but not delivered to the insurance carrier. A transmission failure alert and administrator reports revealed the backlog.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate the carrier connection had expired. The certificate was renewed and queued transmissions were sent.

benefits-service.title: Benefits pages failed to load during identity service outage
benefits-service.description: Employees saw errors when opening their benefits pages even though they were already signed in. Availability alerts showed that benefits-service could not retrieve employee identity details.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The identity dependency was unavailable. Once it recovered, benefits-service resumed loading employee records.

benefits-service.title: Bulk benefits statement generation exhausted service memory
benefits-service.description: Administrators saw statement generation requests fail for large employee populations. Memory alerts and repeated service restarts identified the capacity problem.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The statement generator loaded an entire batch into memory at once. Processing statements in smaller batches reduced memory use and allowed the requests to complete.

benefits-service.title: Dependent eligibility checks took too long
benefits-service.description: Employees waited several minutes for dependent eligibility results and some requests timed out. Latency monitoring traced the delays to database queries.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: An eligibility query scanned dependent records without a suitable index. Adding the index restored normal response times.

benefits-service.title: Some employees were shown incorrect coverage eligibility
benefits-service.description: Employees who should have qualified for coverage were marked ineligible. An administrator noticed discrepancies while reviewing eligibility against employee records.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A failed data import had overwritten employment classification values for a subset of employees. The affected values were restored and eligibility was recalculated.

benefits-service.title: Carrier file uploads failed after DNS resolution errors
benefits-service.description: Carrier enrollment files accumulated without being uploaded. Transfer alerts showed that benefits-service could not resolve the carrier endpoint.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the required resolver entry. Restoring the entry allowed the queued files to upload.

benefits-service.title: Administrators could not download benefits reports
benefits-service.description: Report generation appeared to finish, but administrators received an access error when downloading the files. Support reproduced the issue and found storage access failures in the service logs.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The service account had lost permission to read generated files from object storage. Restoring the read permission fixed report downloads.

benefits-service.title: Carrier rejected new dependent enrollment records
benefits-service.description: Employees could submit enrollments, but dependent records were rejected by the carrier. Rejection alerts and carrier response logs identified the affected submissions.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The carrier API changed the accepted format for dependent relationship values. The integration was updated and rejected records were resent.

benefits-service.title: Life event enrollment reminders were not sent
benefits-service.description: Employees who reported qualifying life events did not receive reminders to update their benefits. An administrator noticed the gap while reviewing notification activity.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled reminder job stopped after encountering an unexpected empty result. The job was corrected and eligible reminders were sent.

benefits-service.title: Enrollment windows closed early for employees in western time zones
benefits-service.description: Some employees were told their enrollment window had closed while it was still open in their local time. Support reports from affected employees revealed the mismatch.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The cutoff calculation used the service clock instead of the tenant's configured time zone. The calculation was fixed and affected enrollment windows were reopened.

benefits-service.title: Rapid enrollment submissions created duplicate elections
benefits-service.description: Some employees saw duplicate benefit elections after submitting the same selection twice. An administrator found the duplicates during a reconciliation review.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent requests could both create an election before either request completed. An idempotency check was added and duplicate elections were removed.

benefits-service.title: Employees saw outdated employer contribution amounts
benefits-service.description: The benefits catalog continued to show old employer contribution amounts after an administrator updated them. The discrepancy was detected when employees compared their previews with the administrator's configuration.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A cache was not invalidated when contribution settings changed. Cache invalidation was corrected and the stale entries were cleared.

benefits-service.title: Payroll deductions were missing for new benefit elections
benefits-service.description: New elections appeared in benefits-service but were absent from the payroll deduction export. A reconciliation check detected the missing deductions before payroll processing.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A mapping error excluded a newly supported coverage tier from the export. The mapping was corrected and the affected deductions were regenerated.

benefits-service.title: Benefits updates stalled behind an invalid queue message
benefits-service.description: Employee coverage changes remained pending and did not reach downstream systems. Queue age alerts showed that processing had stopped.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A malformed message repeatedly blocked the queue consumer. The message was moved aside and the consumer was updated to isolate invalid messages.

benefits-service.title: Plan document previews failed after a file format change
benefits-service.description: Employees could download plan documents but saw errors when opening previews. A rise in preview failures and support reports identified the problem.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The preview renderer did not support a document format introduced by the upload workflow. The renderer was updated to handle that format.

benefits-service.title: Benefits service could not connect to the carrier gateway
benefits-service.description: Coverage updates remained pending because outbound requests to the carrier gateway failed. Connection alerts showed repeated network timeouts.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A firewall rule change blocked outbound traffic on the gateway port. Restoring the rule allowed queued updates to be delivered.

benefits-service.title: Carrier rate limits delayed coverage confirmations
benefits-service.description: Employees waited longer than usual to see confirmation that their coverage had been accepted. Monitoring showed a spike in rate-limit responses from the carrier.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: Benefits-service sent too many confirmation requests at once after a backlog cleared. Request throttling and backoff were added to keep traffic within the carrier's limit.

benefits-service.title: Benefits database migration blocked enrollment writes
benefits-service.description: Employees received errors when saving benefit elections while plan browsing remained available. Database lock alerts and failed write metrics exposed the interruption.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A schema migration held a lock on the elections table longer than expected. The migration was stopped and later replaced with a less disruptive change.

payments-api.title: Payroll payments rejected after release changed amount validation
payments-api.description: Customers could not submit payroll batches containing payments with fractional currency amounts. The support team noticed a rise in rejected batches, and payments-api validation errors confirmed the issue.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A deployment incorrectly required payment amounts to be whole numbers. The change was rolled back and the validation was corrected.

payments-api.title: Bank transfers routed to the wrong processing queue
payments-api.description: Some payroll payments remained pending instead of being sent for processing. Operations detected the backlog while reviewing payment queue metrics.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed one transfer type to a queue with no consumers. The routing was corrected and the queued payments were processed.

payments-api.title: Expired certificate blocked payment gateway connections
payments-api.description: Customers saw payment submission errors because payments-api could not connect to the payment gateway. Connection alerts showed repeated TLS handshake failures.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The client certificate used for gateway connections had expired. The certificate was renewed and the affected connections were restarted.

payments-api.title: Payment status checks failed during bank partner outage
payments-api.description: Payroll administrators could not retrieve current transfer statuses, although previously submitted transfers continued processing. An increase in upstream errors and a partner outage notice revealed the dependency failure.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The bank partner's status service was unavailable. Status checks recovered when the partner restored the service, and delayed updates were reconciled.

payments-api.title: Payment submission latency increased under batch load
payments-api.description: Large payroll runs took much longer to submit, and some requests timed out. Latency alerts and a growing request backlog showed that payments-api was saturated.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The service had too few workers for the volume of concurrent batch submissions. Worker capacity was increased and concurrency limits were adjusted.

payments-api.title: Payment history requests timed out for large employers
payments-api.description: Payroll administrators could not load payment history for employers with many transactions. The issue was detected through timeout alerts and reports from support.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A database query scanned the transaction table without a suitable index. Adding an index and revising the query restored normal response times.

payments-api.title: Corrupted payment state prevented transfer reconciliation
payments-api.description: Some completed transfers continued to appear as pending in payroll reports. A reconciliation check detected a mismatch between stored payment states and bank confirmations.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A failed state migration left invalid status values on a subset of records. The affected values were repaired and reconciliation was rerun.

payments-api.title: DNS failure prevented payments-api from reaching the bank gateway
payments-api.description: New bank transfers failed during submission because payments-api could not resolve the gateway hostname. Network alerts showed repeated DNS lookup failures.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A resolver configuration change removed the required DNS forwarding rule. Restoring the rule allowed transfer submissions to resume.

payments-api.title: Missing permission blocked payment audit records
payments-api.description: Payroll payments were submitted, but their audit history was incomplete. An alert on failed audit writes exposed the problem.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A service permission change removed write access to the audit store. Access was restored and missing audit entries were rebuilt from retained payment events.

payments-api.title: Payment gateway response change broke transfer confirmation
payments-api.description: Customers saw submitted transfers remain in an unknown state instead of receiving confirmation. Engineers detected parsing errors in payments-api logs after the gateway changed its response format.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The gateway changed the type of a response field that payments-api expected to be a string. The parser was updated and affected transfers were reconciled before any retries.

payments-api.title: Scheduled payout reconciliation stopped running
payments-api.description: Completed payouts were not reflected in the payroll dashboard. A monitoring check detected that the scheduled reconciliation job had missed successive runs.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The job scheduler had been left paused after maintenance. The schedule was resumed and the missed reconciliation work was run.

payments-api.title: Duplicate payment requests created multiple transfer attempts
payments-api.description: Some payroll payments were submitted more than once when clients retried requests after a timeout. A duplicate-transfer alert identified matching payments for the same payroll item.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The idempotency check was not atomic when concurrent requests arrived. The check was made transactional, and duplicate attempts were identified and stopped where possible.

payments-api.title: Refund requests failed when payment references contained leading zeros
payments-api.description: Customers could not refund certain payroll-related charges even though the original payments were found. Support reports and failed refund logs pointed to affected payment references.
payments-api.resolution_summary: Reference values were converted to numbers before being sent to the refund processor, stripping leading zeros. The service was changed to preserve references as strings.

payments-api.title: Memory growth caused payment workers to restart
payments-api.description: Payment batches intermittently stalled while workers restarted, delaying transfer processing. Memory alerts and restart counts revealed the repeated failures.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A cache of bank response objects grew without a size limit. The cache was bounded and workers recovered after the fix was deployed.

payments-api.title: Bank account verification requests returned authorization errors
payments-api.description: Customers could not verify new bank accounts for payroll funding. A spike in authorization failures from the verification provider triggered an alert.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The provider credential had been rotated without updating payments-api. The service configuration was updated with the current credential and verification requests resumed.

payments-api.title: Payment webhook backlog delayed payroll status updates
payments-api.description: Payroll administrators saw transfers remain in processing after the bank had completed them. Queue monitoring detected a growing backlog of payment webhooks.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A webhook consumer was repeatedly retrying malformed messages and blocking subsequent messages. Invalid messages were moved to a separate queue and the backlog was drained.

payments-api.title: Currency rounding caused small differences in payroll totals
payments-api.description: Some payroll batch totals differed from the sum shown in payments-api by a small amount. A customer report led to a comparison of calculated totals and individual payment amounts.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The service rounded intermediate decimal values before summing them. The calculation was changed to use fixed-precision amounts and round only at the currency boundary.

payments-api.title: Payment cancellation failed while transfers were still eligible
payments-api.description: Payroll administrators received errors when attempting to cancel transfers that had not yet been sent to the bank. Support escalated the reports after confirming the transfers were still pending.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A stale cancellation rule treated an internal queued state as already submitted. The rule was corrected and affected eligible transfers were cancelled.

payments-api.title: Database connection leak interrupted payment submissions
payments-api.description: Customers received intermittent errors when submitting payroll payments. Connection pool alerts showed that payments-api was exhausting its available database connections.
payments-api.resolution_summary: An error path failed to return database connections to the pool. The connection handling was fixed and the service was restarted to release stranded connections.

payments-api.title: Funding balance checks used outdated account balances
payments-api.description: Some payroll batches were incorrectly rejected for insufficient funds after customers had added money. Support reports and balance comparisons exposed stale results from payments-api.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A balance cache was not invalidated when funding events arrived. Invalidation was repaired and cached balances were refreshed.

billing-service.title: New subscriptions fail during checkout
billing-service.description: Administrators saw an error after submitting payment details for a new subscription. Checkout error alerts and support reports revealed that no subscriptions were being created.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an incompatible request field in the payment authorization flow. Rolling back the deployment restored checkout.

billing-service.title: Invoices show an incorrect tax rate
billing-service.description: Some customers received invoices with tax calculated at the wrong rate. A finance reconciliation check detected the mismatch before affected invoices were paid.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change applied the default tax rate to customers in several regions. The tax rules were corrected and affected invoices were reissued.

billing-service.title: Card payments fail because the payment gateway certificate expired
billing-service.description: Customers could not pay open invoices by card. Payment failure alerts showed that billing-service could not establish a secure connection to the payment gateway.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used for the gateway connection had expired. Replacing the certificate restored payment processing.

billing-service.title: Payment status updates are delayed during gateway outage
billing-service.description: Customers who completed payments continued to see their invoices marked as unpaid. Monitoring showed that the payment gateway was unavailable when billing-service tried to retrieve transaction status.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The gateway outage prevented status checks from completing. Once the gateway recovered, billing-service retried the checks and updated the affected invoices.

billing-service.title: Invoice downloads fail for accounts with long billing histories
billing-service.description: Administrators with extensive billing histories received errors when downloading invoices. Memory alerts and application logs showed billing-service restarting during large document requests.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The download handler loaded all historical invoice documents into memory for each request. Streaming only the requested document removed the memory pressure.

billing-service.title: Billing history page takes several minutes to load
billing-service.description: Customers with many invoices experienced long delays when opening billing history. Database monitoring identified a query that became slower as invoice records accumulated.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The billing history query was missing an index on the account and invoice creation fields. Adding the index restored normal page load times.

billing-service.title: Seat-based charges are duplicated on some invoices
billing-service.description: Some customers saw the same seat charge twice on their invoices. A reconciliation report flagged invoice totals that exceeded the corresponding subscription usage.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A retry after a partial write created duplicate charge records. The duplicate records were removed, affected invoices were corrected, and the write operation was made idempotent.

billing-service.title: Billing portal cannot reach the tax calculation service
billing-service.description: Customers changing subscription plans saw an error instead of an updated price estimate. Connection alerts showed that billing-service could not resolve the tax service hostname.
billing-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record pointed the tax service hostname to an invalid address. Correcting the record restored tax estimates.

billing-service.title: Administrators cannot download invoice PDFs
billing-service.description: Authorized billing administrators received an access error when downloading invoice PDFs. Support reports and access logs showed that invoice metadata remained visible but document retrieval was denied.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the billing-service role's access to stored invoice documents. Restoring the required read permission fixed downloads.

billing-service.title: Saved cards cannot be updated after payment API change
billing-service.description: Customers attempting to replace a saved card saw a validation error. Integration error alerts showed that the payment provider was rejecting update requests.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed the accepted format for card update requests. Billing-service was updated to send the required format.

billing-service.title: Subscription renewals do not generate invoices
billing-service.description: Customers reaching the end of their billing period did not receive renewal invoices. A scheduled job alert showed that the renewal process had stopped before creating invoice records.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The renewal job failed when it encountered a malformed subscription record and did not continue to other accounts. The record was repaired, the job was rerun, and error handling was added to isolate invalid records.

billing-service.title: Usage charges are missing from monthly invoices
billing-service.description: Invoices for some workforce accounts omitted charges for active employee seats. Finance checks detected a gap between usage reports and invoice line items.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A usage import consumed an incomplete export and marked the period as processed. The complete usage data was imported and affected invoices were corrected.

billing-service.title: Customers receive repeated payment reminder emails
billing-service.description: Some customers received multiple reminders for the same unpaid invoice. Support reports and notification logs showed that reminders were sent again whenever the queue retried a message.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The reminder worker did not record successful sends before acknowledging messages. A delivery marker was added so retries no longer sent duplicate reminders.

billing-service.title: Discount codes are rejected for eligible subscriptions
billing-service.description: Administrators saw an invalid code message when applying valid subscription discounts. A rise in discount validation failures was detected by application monitoring.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A rule change compared subscription plan names with outdated eligibility values. Updating the eligibility mapping restored discount validation.

billing-service.title: Refunds remain pending after successful gateway processing
billing-service.description: Customers saw refunds marked as pending even after funds had been returned by the payment gateway. Reconciliation alerts identified a growing difference between gateway refunds and billing-service records.
billing-service.resolution_summary: Refund webhook events were routed to a queue that no worker consumed. Routing the events to the active queue and replaying them updated the refund records.

billing-service.title: Plan changes create incorrect prorated charges
billing-service.description: Customers changing plans mid-cycle saw prorated charges that did not match the remaining subscription period. Support escalations and invoice reviews revealed the calculation error.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The proration calculation rounded the remaining period before applying the plan price difference. The calculation was corrected and affected accounts received credits.

billing-service.title: Billing dashboard displays another account's invoice total
billing-service.description: Some administrators saw an invoice total that did not belong to their account on the billing dashboard. A customer report led to a review of dashboard cache entries.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The cache key omitted the account identifier for invoice summary data. The cache was cleared and the key was corrected to isolate account data.

billing-service.title: New payment methods fail during traffic spike
billing-service.description: Customers experienced timeouts while adding payment methods during a period of high demand. Connection pool alerts showed that billing-service had exhausted its available database connections.
billing-service.resolution_summary: Payment method requests held database connections open while waiting for the gateway. Releasing connections before the external call and adjusting pool limits restored capacity.

billing-service.title: Canceled subscriptions continue to appear as active
billing-service.description: Administrators who canceled subscriptions still saw an active status in the billing portal. Monitoring detected failures in the consumer responsible for applying cancellation events.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A poison message blocked the cancellation event queue. The message was corrected, queued events were replayed, and the consumer was changed to isolate malformed messages.

billing-service.title: Credit balances are not applied to new invoices
billing-service.description: Customers with available account credits received invoices for the full amount due. A finance audit detected unapplied balances on newly finalized invoices.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The invoice finalization process skipped credit application for accounts migrated from an older billing format. The migration mapping was corrected and credits were applied to affected invoices.

checkout-service.title: Checkout shows a blank page after selecting an annual plan
checkout-service.description: Administrators selecting an annual subscription saw a blank checkout page and could not complete their purchase. Support reports and a drop in completed checkouts revealed the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A checkout-service deployment introduced a frontend error when loading annual pricing. The deployment was rolled back and the pricing response handler was corrected.

checkout-service.title: Card payments decline after a payment configuration change
checkout-service.description: Customers entering valid card details received a generic payment failure and could not purchase subscriptions or add-ons. An alert on the checkout-service payment decline rate detected the increase.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed checkout-service to an unsupported payment processing account. Restoring the correct account configuration resolved the failures.

checkout-service.title: Checkout cannot establish a secure connection to the payment gateway
checkout-service.description: Customers saw a payment unavailable message when attempting to complete checkout. Checkout-service connection errors triggered an alert before support received reports.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used by checkout-service to connect to the payment gateway had expired. Renewing the certificate and restarting the affected connections restored payments.

checkout-service.title: Subscription purchases fail while the tax calculation provider is unavailable
checkout-service.description: Customers could review their selected plan but could not see a final total or place an order. Checkout-service tax calculation failures and customer reports identified the problem.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The external tax calculation provider was unavailable. Checkout completed normally after the provider recovered and queued calculation requests were retried.

checkout-service.title: Checkout requests time out during a surge in benefit enrollment purchases
checkout-service.description: Administrators purchasing benefit enrollment add-ons saw long loading screens and timeout errors. Checkout-service latency and request queue alerts detected the backlog.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Checkout-service had too few workers for the surge in requests. Increasing worker capacity and adjusting autoscaling thresholds cleared the queue.

checkout-service.title: Large workforce subscriptions take too long to load at checkout
checkout-service.description: Administrators with large employee counts waited several minutes for the order summary, and some requests timed out. Checkout-service query latency alerts identified the affected requests.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: An unindexed database query scanned the full pricing history for each employee tier. Adding an index and narrowing the query restored normal response times.

checkout-service.title: Checkout displays incorrect totals for a small set of subscription renewals
checkout-service.description: Some administrators saw renewal totals that did not match their contracted prices and stopped before paying. Support escalations led the team to compare checkout-service totals with contract records.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A data import had corrupted price tier values for a subset of contracts. The affected values were restored from verified records and the import validation was tightened.
