checkout-service.title: Checkout cannot reach the subscription catalog
checkout-service.description: Customers saw an empty plan selection or an error when starting checkout. Checkout-service dependency alerts showed repeated failures to resolve the catalog endpoint.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change sent catalog lookups to an unavailable resolver. Restoring the resolver configuration allowed checkout-service to load plans again.

checkout-service.title: Administrators cannot apply approved discounts at checkout
checkout-service.description: Customers entering valid discount codes were told that the codes could not be verified. Support reports and checkout-service authorization logs revealed the failure.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed checkout-service access to the discount rules store. Restoring the required read permission fixed discount validation.

checkout-service.title: Saved payment methods disappear from the checkout page
checkout-service.description: Returning customers were asked to enter card details again because their saved payment methods did not appear. An increase in checkout-service response parsing errors exposed the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The payment provider changed the structure of its saved-method response. Checkout-service was updated to handle the new response format.

checkout-service.title: Expired checkout reservations prevent customers from purchasing available add-ons
checkout-service.description: Customers attempting to purchase workforce add-ons were told their selections were already reserved. Support reports prompted an investigation of stale checkout-service reservations.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job that releases expired reservations had stopped after an unhandled error. Restarting the job and removing the stale reservations restored purchasing.

checkout-service.title: Duplicate subscription orders appear after customers retry a payment
checkout-service.description: Some customers who retried after a slow payment response received two order confirmations. Reconciliation alerts and support reports identified duplicate orders created by checkout-service.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The retry path generated a new idempotency key for each attempt. Checkout-service was changed to reuse the original key, and duplicate charges were refunded.

checkout-service.title: Checkout totals omit tax for certain billing addresses
checkout-service.description: Customers with billing addresses in affected regions saw a lower total than expected. A finance reconciliation check found orders with missing tax amounts.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Checkout-service mapped a regional address code to the wrong tax jurisdiction. Correcting the mapping fixed new totals, and affected orders were reviewed.

checkout-service.title: Checkout sessions are lost when customers return from card verification
checkout-service.description: Customers who completed card verification returned to an empty checkout and had to start again. Checkout-service session reset metrics and support reports revealed the pattern.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The session cookie lacked the setting needed for the cross-site verification redirect. Updating the cookie configuration preserved sessions through verification.

checkout-service.title: Orders remain pending after successful card authorization
checkout-service.description: Customers saw their checkout remain pending even though their card had been authorized. A growing checkout-service pending-order queue triggered an alert.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The event consumer responsible for recording payment confirmations had stopped after encountering a malformed message. The message was isolated and the consumer restarted to process the backlog.

checkout-service.title: Checkout crashes while generating invoices for multi-entity customers
checkout-service.description: Administrators buying a subscription for several legal entities received an error after submitting checkout. Checkout-service memory alerts and crash logs identified the affected requests.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Invoice generation loaded every entity document into memory at once. Streaming the documents reduced memory use and stopped the crashes.

checkout-service.title: Plan upgrades show the wrong prorated charge
checkout-service.description: Customers upgrading their workforce plan saw a prorated amount that did not match the remaining billing period. Support compared checkout-service quotes with subscription records and detected the discrepancy.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The proration calculation used the start of the current period instead of its end. Correcting the calculation fixed new quotes, and affected charges were adjusted.

checkout-service.title: Checkout rejects bank account payments with valid account details
checkout-service.description: Customers choosing bank account payment received a validation error before they could submit their order. Support reports and a rise in checkout-service validation failures exposed the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A new validation rule incorrectly rejected account numbers with leading zeros. The rule was corrected and affected customers were able to retry.

checkout-service.title: Checkout fails when applying account credit to an order
checkout-service.description: Customers with available account credit saw an error when placing an order that used the credit. Checkout-service transaction failure alerts identified the affected orders.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent credit updates caused database deadlocks between checkout-service and the credit ledger. Using a consistent lock order prevented the deadlocks.

checkout-service.title: Customers receive order confirmation before payment has completed
checkout-service.description: Some customers received a confirmation for an order whose payment later failed, causing confusion about their subscription status. Support reports led the team to compare checkout-service notifications with payment records.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A release triggered confirmation messages when payment was initiated rather than when it succeeded. Moving the notification trigger to the confirmed payment state fixed the issue.

order-service.title: Checkout creates duplicate equipment orders
order-service.description: Some employees saw two equipment orders after submitting checkout once. Support detected the issue after customers reported duplicate confirmation messages.
order-service.resolution_summary: A deployment caused the checkout handler to retry successful order writes. The handler was corrected and duplicate orders were canceled.

order-service.title: Orders show incorrect sales tax at checkout
order-service.description: Some customers saw sales tax calculated using the wrong shipping region. Finance detected the discrepancy while reconciling order totals.
order-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change mapped several regions to the wrong tax rules. The mappings were corrected and affected totals were recalculated.

order-service.title: Payment authorization fails for new orders
order-service.description: Customers could not complete orders because payment authorization requests failed. An increase in checkout errors alerted the on-call team.
order-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by order-service to connect to the payment gateway had expired. Renewing the certificate restored authorization.

order-service.title: Equipment orders remain pending when inventory is unavailable
order-service.description: New equipment orders remained pending instead of moving to fulfillment. The operations team noticed a growing queue of unconfirmed orders.
order-service.resolution_summary: The inventory dependency was unavailable, so order-service could not reserve stock. Pending orders were retried after the dependency recovered.

order-service.title: Bulk orders fail during large equipment purchases
order-service.description: Administrators submitting large equipment orders received errors before checkout completed. Memory alerts and failed request metrics exposed the problem.
order-service.resolution_summary: Order-service loaded every item image into memory while validating bulk orders. Removing the image loads and limiting batch size stopped the failures.

order-service.title: Order history takes too long to load for large tenants
order-service.description: Administrators with extensive order histories saw the order list time out. Slow request alerts identified the affected endpoint.
order-service.resolution_summary: The order history query scanned the full orders table when filtering by tenant and status. A composite index reduced query time.

order-service.title: Order details fail to open for migrated records
order-service.description: Some older orders appeared in the list but could not be opened. Support found the pattern after customers reported errors on specific records.
order-service.resolution_summary: A migration stored malformed item data in a subset of orders. The data was repaired and validation was added to the migration process.

order-service.title: Order confirmations are not delivered
order-service.description: Customers completed orders but did not receive confirmation messages. Monitoring detected a growing backlog of notification requests.
order-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record prevented order-service from reaching the notification service. Correcting the record allowed the queued confirmations to be sent.

order-service.title: Administrators cannot cancel unfulfilled orders
order-service.description: Authorized administrators received permission errors when canceling orders that had not shipped. Support reproduced the problem using an affected account.
order-service.resolution_summary: The cancellation permission was missing from the administrator role mapping. Restoring the permission allowed eligible orders to be canceled.

order-service.title: Shipping quotes disappear from equipment checkout
order-service.description: Customers could not select a shipping method for equipment orders. Checkout monitoring showed that requests for shipping quotes were failing.
order-service.resolution_summary: The shipping provider changed a response field that order-service required. The response parser was updated to accept the new format.

order-service.title: Expired order reservations continue to hold inventory
order-service.description: Available equipment appeared out of stock even though many pending orders had expired. The fulfillment team detected a mismatch between reservations and active orders.
order-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled reservation cleanup job had stopped running after a job configuration error. The schedule was repaired and expired reservations were released.

order-service.title: Order submissions fail intermittently across service connections
order-service.description: Some customers received an error when placing an order and had to try again. Connection reset alerts showed failures between order-service and its database.
order-service.resolution_summary: A network rule dropped long-lived database connections without notifying the application. Updating the rule and enabling connection validation restored reliable submissions.

order-service.title: Shipped orders receive repeated fulfillment updates
order-service.description: Some order timelines displayed the same shipment update multiple times. The fulfillment team noticed duplicate entries while checking customer inquiries.
order-service.resolution_summary: Order-service processed redelivered fulfillment messages without checking their event identifiers. Deduplication was added and duplicate timeline entries were removed.

order-service.title: Checkout uses outdated prices for payroll add-ons
order-service.description: Some administrators saw old prices when ordering payroll add-ons. The discrepancy was detected when finance compared completed orders with the current price list.
order-service.resolution_summary: Price cache entries were not invalidated when the catalog changed. Cache invalidation was fixed and affected orders were reviewed.

order-service.title: Equipment orders exceed available stock
order-service.description: Customers received confirmations for equipment that could not be fulfilled. Warehouse reconciliation showed that more units had been ordered than were available.
order-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent checkouts could reserve the same remaining stock before either reservation was committed. Atomic stock reservation prevented further overselling.

order-service.title: Order invoice downloads return errors
order-service.description: Customers could view completed orders but could not download their invoices. An alert fired when invoice generation failures increased.
order-service.resolution_summary: Temporary invoice files filled the storage volume used by order-service. Removing stale files and adding automatic cleanup restored downloads.

order-service.title: Order status updates stall during simultaneous changes
order-service.description: Some order status changes timed out when fulfillment and cancellation updates arrived together. Database monitoring showed an increase in deadlocks.
order-service.resolution_summary: The two update paths acquired order and item locks in different sequences. Using a consistent lock order eliminated the deadlocks.

order-service.title: Fulfillment requests fail authentication
order-service.description: Confirmed equipment orders stopped progressing to fulfillment. The operations team detected repeated authentication failures in the fulfillment queue.
order-service.resolution_summary: Clock drift on order-service hosts made signed fulfillment requests appear expired. Time synchronization was restored and queued requests were retried.

order-service.title: Orders with accented recipient names cannot be submitted
order-service.description: Some employees received a validation error when entering recipient names with accented characters. Support identified the common input pattern from failed order reports.
order-service.resolution_summary: A new name validator accepted only a limited character set. The validator was updated to support valid international characters.

order-service.title: Order search shows results from another tenant
order-service.description: Some administrators saw order summaries belonging to another tenant in search results. A customer report prompted the team to investigate and disable the affected search endpoint.
order-service.resolution_summary: A search query omitted the tenant filter for one combination of search criteria. The filter was restored and access controls were tested across all search paths.

inventory-service.title: Equipment counts dropped to zero after a deploy
inventory-service.description: Users saw zero available laptops in inventory-service even though stock was present. The issue blocked equipment assignments and was detected through a sudden rise in failed allocation requests.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the stock-count response field without updating the reader. Rolling back the change and restoring the field mapping corrected the counts.

inventory-service.title: Equipment reservations expired before onboarding was complete
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service released reserved equipment while HR staff were still preparing new-hire assignments. Users reported that items disappeared from onboarding orders.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change reduced the reservation lifetime from days to minutes. Restoring the intended setting stopped premature releases.

inventory-service.title: Barcode scanners could not submit stock updates
inventory-service.description: Warehouse staff could scan equipment, but inventory-service rejected the resulting stock updates. The failure was detected when scanner sync errors increased and staff reported growing backlogs.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the scanner gateway had expired. Renewing the certificate and restarting the gateway restored updates.

inventory-service.title: Equipment photos failed to load in inventory records
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service showed blank image panels on equipment records, making visually similar models harder to distinguish. An increase in image fetch errors alerted the support team.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The object storage dependency was unavailable. Image loading recovered when the storage provider restored access.

inventory-service.title: Large inventory imports caused service restarts
inventory-service.description: Bulk equipment imports stalled and some inventory-service requests failed while the service restarted. Memory alerts and reports of incomplete imports exposed the issue.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The importer loaded entire files into memory instead of processing them in batches. Streaming the rows and limiting concurrent imports prevented further restarts.

inventory-service.title: Equipment search timed out for tenants with many assets
inventory-service.description: Users with large equipment catalogs saw inventory-service searches time out, delaying assignments and returns. Database latency alerts identified the slowdown.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A search query scanned the full asset table when filtering by location. Adding a suitable index and updating the query restored normal search times.

inventory-service.title: Returned equipment appeared twice in stock history
inventory-service.description: Some returned devices appeared to add two units to inventory-service stock history. A reconciliation report detected a mismatch between physical counts and recorded quantities.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A retry path wrote the same return movement twice. Duplicate movements were corrected and the write path was made idempotent.

inventory-service.title: Inventory-service could not resolve the location directory
inventory-service.description: Equipment records failed to load their assigned office locations, and users could not complete location transfers. Connection failures were detected by a dependency health check.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A stale DNS entry pointed inventory-service to an unavailable directory endpoint. Refreshing the DNS configuration restored connectivity.

inventory-service.title: Inventory managers could not adjust stock quantities
inventory-service.description: Users with inventory manager access received permission errors when recording damaged or missing equipment. Support detected the issue after several managers reported rejected adjustments.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A permissions update omitted the stock adjustment action from the manager role. Restoring the action to the role allowed adjustments again.

inventory-service.title: Supplier orders failed validation during submission
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service could not submit replenishment orders to the supplier integration. Users saw validation errors, and the order failure alert notified the operations team.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The supplier API changed the required unit-of-measure field. Updating the integration mapping allowed new orders to be submitted.

inventory-service.title: Low-stock replenishment requests were not created
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service showed supplies below their reorder thresholds but did not create replenishment requests. Staff noticed missing requests while reviewing low-stock items.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled reorder job had stopped after an unhandled error on an archived item. The job was repaired, and a catch-up run created the missing requests.

inventory-service.title: Equipment transfers stalled when locations were updated together
inventory-service.description: Some transfers between offices remained pending in inventory-service. Database lock alerts and user reports revealed that simultaneous transfers were blocking one another.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: Transfer transactions locked source and destination stock rows in inconsistent order, causing deadlocks. Enforcing a consistent lock order resolved the failures.

inventory-service.title: Employee equipment assignments stopped updating
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service continued to show equipment against former assignees after changes were submitted. A growing message queue and reports from HR staff exposed the delay.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A malformed assignment event repeatedly crashed the queue consumer. The event was isolated and validation was added so later events could be processed.

inventory-service.title: Two employees were assigned the same available laptop
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service confirmed two assignments for a single laptop when requests arrived at nearly the same time. Staff detected the conflict while preparing equipment for new hires.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent allocation requests both read the item as available before either saved its assignment. An atomic availability check and update prevented duplicate allocation.

inventory-service.title: Returned devices remained unavailable in the equipment catalog
inventory-service.description: Users recorded device returns, but inventory-service continued to show the devices as unavailable. Support found that the catalog view disagreed with the return history.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The return operation did not invalidate the cached availability record. Adding cache invalidation made returned devices visible as available.

inventory-service.title: Inventory exports failed when audit storage filled up
inventory-service.description: Users could not download equipment inventory exports from inventory-service. Disk usage alerts showed that export generation had stopped.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: Accumulated audit files filled the storage volume used for temporary exports. Removing old files and enforcing a retention limit restored export generation.

inventory-service.title: Deleted equipment categories reappeared in stock reports
inventory-service.description: Inventory-service reports included archived categories that users had removed from active views. The discrepancy was detected during a routine stock review.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The reporting query did not exclude archived category records. Updating the filter removed those categories from active stock reports.

inventory-service.title: Inventory imports rejected valid asset tags with leading zeros
inventory-service.description: Bulk imports into inventory-service rejected some valid equipment records or reported duplicate asset tags. Users noticed that affected tags all began with zero.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The import parser converted asset tags to numbers, stripping leading zeros. Treating tags as text and reprocessing the affected rows fixed the records.

inventory-service.title: Stock change notifications were delayed by API throttling
inventory-service.description: Users received low-stock notifications hours after inventory-service recorded the changes. Queue monitoring showed a backlog of notification deliveries.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The notification provider applied a lower request limit than the sender expected. Rate limiting and retry backoff allowed the backlog to clear.

inventory-service.title: Equipment check-in requests failed during a schema migration
inventory-service.description: Users could not check returned equipment into inventory-service, leaving devices unavailable for reassignment. A rise in database errors exposed the failure.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A schema migration removed a column before all check-in code paths had stopped using it. Restoring the column and sequencing the migration correctly restored check-ins.

shipping-service.title: Equipment shipments fail after a shipping-service deploy
shipping-service.description: Administrators could submit equipment requests, but shipping-service failed to create shipments. An alert on failed shipment creation exposed the problem.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the shipment request format without updating the carrier adapter. The deploy was rolled back and the adapter was corrected before release.

shipping-service.title: Payroll check shipments use the wrong delivery speed
shipping-service.description: Payroll administrators saw standard delivery selected for check shipments that required expedited delivery. The issue was detected when a support agent compared shipment options with tenant settings.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the default delivery speed incorrectly. The configuration was restored and affected shipments were upgraded where possible.

shipping-service.title: Shipping labels cannot be purchased after certificate expiry
shipping-service.description: Users received errors when requesting labels for employee equipment. Shipping-service alerts showed repeated secure connection failures to the label provider.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate shipping-service to the provider had expired. The certificate was renewed and failed label requests were retried.

shipping-service.title: Carrier outage delays benefit card shipments
shipping-service.description: Benefit card shipments remained pending after administrators submitted them. A rise in carrier errors and provider status reports identified the external outage.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The carrier's shipment creation API was unavailable. Shipping-service resumed processing queued requests after the carrier restored the API.

shipping-service.title: Large shipping batches exhaust worker memory
shipping-service.description: Bulk equipment shipments stalled and some administrators saw batch processing errors. Worker restart alerts revealed that shipping-service was running out of memory.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Workers loaded entire batches and their label documents into memory at once. Processing was changed to handle smaller chunks, and interrupted batches were resumed.

shipping-service.title: Shipment history takes too long to load for large tenants
shipping-service.description: Administrators with extensive shipping histories saw the shipment list time out. Database latency alerts and support reports pointed to shipping-service.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A shipment history query sorted a large table without a suitable index. Adding the index and limiting results per page restored normal response times.

shipping-service.title: Some return labels show corrupted destination addresses
shipping-service.description: Employees received equipment return labels with incomplete warehouse addresses. A warehouse operator reported parcels arriving with unreadable destination fields.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: An import process truncated address records when an optional field was missing. The affected records were repaired and the import validation was fixed.

shipping-service.title: Shipping-service cannot resolve the carrier host
shipping-service.description: New shipments and tracking lookups failed for users across multiple tenants. Connection alerts showed that shipping-service could not resolve the carrier endpoint.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the resolver needed for the carrier domain. Restoring the resolver configuration returned shipment processing to normal.

shipping-service.title: Managers cannot download equipment return labels
shipping-service.description: Managers could create return requests but received access errors when downloading labels. Support reproduced the failure and found permission errors in shipping-service logs.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The shipping-service account lost read access to the label storage location. The required permission was restored and affected users could download their labels.

shipping-service.title: Carrier API change rejects shipments with phone numbers
shipping-service.description: Equipment shipments containing employee phone numbers failed at carrier submission. Shipping-service alerts detected an increase in rejected requests.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The carrier changed its accepted phone number format. The adapter was updated to send the new format, and rejected shipments were resubmitted.

shipping-service.title: Tracking statuses stop updating overnight
shipping-service.description: Administrators saw shipments remain in transit after packages had been delivered. A scheduled job monitor showed that the shipping-service tracking refresh had not completed.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The refresh job failed when it encountered an archived shipment. The job was fixed to skip archived records and rerun to update stale statuses.

shipping-service.title: One malformed request blocks a shipment queue
shipping-service.description: New equipment shipments stayed pending even though requests were accepted. Queue age alerts showed that a shipping-service worker was repeatedly processing the same message.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A malformed message caused the worker to retry indefinitely without moving it aside. The message was removed and retry limits with a dead-letter queue were added.

shipping-service.title: Bulk label purchases hit carrier rate limits
shipping-service.description: Large payroll check mailing batches produced intermittent label purchase errors. Shipping-service metrics showed a spike in rate-limit responses from the carrier.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Batch workers sent label requests faster than the carrier allowed. A shared request limiter and delayed retries were added, and failed labels were purchased.

shipping-service.title: International employee addresses fail validation
shipping-service.description: Administrators could not create equipment shipments for some employees with accented characters in their addresses. Support reports identified the failures in shipping-service address validation.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The validator accepted only a limited character set. It was updated to support valid international characters, and affected requests were resubmitted.

shipping-service.title: Delivery notifications are rejected by webhook verification
shipping-service.description: Delivered packages continued to appear in transit for administrators. Monitoring showed that shipping-service was rejecting carrier delivery notifications.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The webhook verifier used an outdated signing secret after a planned rotation. The current secret was configured and missed delivery updates were reconciled.

shipping-service.title: Retried shipment requests create duplicate equipment orders
shipping-service.description: Some employees received duplicate equipment shipments after administrators retried requests that appeared to time out. The fulfillment team noticed repeated orders for the same request.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Shipping-service generated a new idempotency key for each retry. It was changed to reuse the original key, and duplicate orders were canceled where possible.

shipping-service.title: Label downloads fail while document storage is unavailable
shipping-service.description: Administrators could purchase shipping labels but could not download the resulting documents. Storage availability alerts showed that shipping-service could not retrieve label files.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The document storage dependency was unavailable. Downloads recovered when storage was restored, and missing label files were retrieved again from the carrier.

shipping-service.title: Shipment requests expire because worker clocks are out of sync
shipping-service.description: Some shipment submissions failed with authorization errors even though credentials were valid. Shipping-service logs showed that signed requests had timestamps outside the carrier's accepted window.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Clock synchronization had stopped on a group of workers. Synchronization was restored and failed requests were retried.

shipping-service.title: Canceled equipment requests still produce shipping labels
shipping-service.description: Administrators found labels for equipment requests they had canceled before fulfillment. A reconciliation report detected labels linked to canceled requests.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A race condition allowed label creation to continue after cancellation. Shipment state checks were made atomic, and unused labels were voided.

shipping-service.title: Return shipments are assigned to the wrong warehouse
shipping-service.description: Some employee equipment returns were routed to a warehouse that could not accept them. Warehouse staff reported the misrouted parcels to support.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A cached warehouse routing table was not invalidated after tenant routing settings changed. Cache invalidation was fixed and affected returns were redirected.

notification-service.title: Payslip emails were sent without download links
notification-service.description: Employees received payslip notifications with an empty space where the download link should have appeared. Support reports and a template rendering check identified the problem.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A deploy renamed the link variable without updating the email template. The template was corrected and affected notifications were resent.

notification-service.title: Shift change push notifications stopped reaching mobile devices
notification-service.description: Employees did not receive push alerts when managers changed their shifts. A drop in successful push deliveries triggered an alert.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The push provider certificate had expired. The certificate was renewed and queued alerts were delivered.

notification-service.title: Payroll approval reminders were delivered hours late
notification-service.description: Payroll approvers received reminders after their usual review window. Queue age monitoring detected the growing delay.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A worker concurrency setting had been reduced during a configuration change. The previous limit was restored and the backlog was processed.

notification-service.title: Time-off decision emails were rejected by the delivery provider
notification-service.description: Employees did not receive emails confirming approved or rejected time-off requests. Delivery failure alerts showed that the provider was rejecting requests.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed a required API field and the notification-service still sent the old format. The integration was updated and failed messages were retried.

notification-service.title: New employee welcome messages were sent twice
notification-service.description: Some new employees received duplicate welcome notifications. Tenant administrators reported the duplicates, and message logs confirmed repeated delivery.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A retry handler failed to record successful sends before acknowledging queue messages. The handler was fixed and duplicate suppression was added.

notification-service.title: Bulk schedule notifications exhausted worker memory
notification-service.description: Large schedule publications produced incomplete notification batches. Worker restarts and memory alerts revealed the failure.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The batch processor loaded all recipients into memory at once. It was changed to process recipients in smaller pages, and missed batches were replayed.

notification-service.title: Notification preferences took too long to load
notification-service.description: Users saw timeouts when opening their notification preferences. Latency monitoring and support reports identified the issue.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A database query scanned the entire preference history for each user. An index and a narrower query restored normal response times.

notification-service.title: SMS alerts for missed shifts were not sent
notification-service.description: Managers did not receive SMS alerts for missed shifts. Delivery monitoring showed that requests to the messaging provider were failing.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The messaging provider experienced an outage. The notification-service retained failed messages and delivered them after the provider recovered.

notification-service.title: Overtime approval alerts went to former managers
notification-service.description: Some overtime approval alerts were sent to managers who no longer supervised the employees involved. An administrator noticed that the intended approvers had not been notified.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A stale recipient cache was not invalidated when reporting lines changed. Cache invalidation was corrected and the affected approvals were renotified.

notification-service.title: Daily timesheet reminders stopped running
notification-service.description: Employees with incomplete timesheets did not receive their daily reminders. A scheduled job monitoring alert showed that no reminder batches had started.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The scheduler failed to register the reminder job after a process restart. Job registration was fixed and a startup check was added.

notification-service.title: Email notifications displayed the wrong language
notification-service.description: Some employees received notifications in a language different from the one selected in their profile. Support tickets identified the mismatch across several tenants.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The notification-service used the tenant default instead of the recipient preference when selecting a template. The selection order was corrected.

notification-service.title: Notification-service could not resolve the email gateway
notification-service.description: Email notifications accumulated without being sent. Network alerts and connection logs showed repeated failures to resolve the gateway hostname.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the gateway record used by the service. The record was restored and queued emails were sent.

notification-service.title: Document signing reminders failed for newly uploaded documents
notification-service.description: Employees did not receive reminders to sign newly uploaded documents. An alert on failed reminder creation exposed the problem.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The notification-service lost permission to read document metadata after a role change. The required read permission was restored and affected reminders were recreated.

notification-service.title: Mobile push alerts opened the wrong screen
notification-service.description: Tapping a shift swap alert opened the general schedule instead of the relevant request. Users reported the incorrect navigation after receiving otherwise valid alerts.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A deploy generated push links with an obsolete route. The link builder was updated to use the current route.

notification-service.title: Notification history showed messages from another tenant
notification-service.description: Some administrators saw notification history entries belonging to a different tenant. A customer report prompted a review of history responses.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A history query omitted the tenant filter for one search path. The filter was added and access to the affected query was temporarily disabled while the fix was applied.

notification-service.title: Notification digests contained repeated entries
notification-service.description: Employees received daily digests listing the same activity multiple times. Support reports and a review of stored digest items confirmed the repetitions.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A recovery script inserted duplicate digest records after a job interruption. The duplicate records were removed and a uniqueness constraint was added.

notification-service.title: Email unsubscribe links returned an error
notification-service.description: Recipients could not update email notification preferences using unsubscribe links. An automated link check detected the errors.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A signing key rotation left the link verifier using the previous key. The verifier configuration was updated and recently issued links became valid.

notification-service.title: Payroll completion notifications stalled behind marketing messages
notification-service.description: Employees received payroll completion notifications later than expected. Queue monitoring showed that payroll messages were waiting behind a large noncritical campaign.
notification-service.resolution_summary: Both message types shared a queue without priority controls. Payroll notifications were moved to a dedicated queue and the backlog was cleared.

notification-service.title: Shift reminder times were incorrect after a time zone change
notification-service.description: Some employees received shift reminders at the wrong local time after changing their profile time zone. User reports revealed a consistent offset in scheduled reminders.
notification-service.resolution_summary: Previously scheduled reminders retained the old time zone when the profile changed. The service was updated to reschedule pending reminders using the new time zone.

notification-service.title: Notification attachments failed to download
notification-service.description: Recipients saw an error when opening attachments from payroll notification emails. An increase in attachment access failures triggered an alert.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The service generated attachment links with an expiration period shorter than the email delivery delay. The link lifetime was corrected and affected notifications were resent.

email-service.title: Payslip notification emails fail after a template deployment
email-service.description: Employees did not receive emails announcing that new payslips were available. The email-service rejected the messages during rendering, and support noticed an increase in missing notification reports.
email-service.resolution_summary: A template deployment referenced a field that was not included in payslip events. The team restored the previous template and added a rendering test.

email-service.title: New hire invitations are sent with an expired link
email-service.description: New hires received invitation emails but could not open their onboarding links. The issue delayed account setup and was detected through failed invitation acceptance reports.
email-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the link lifetime to zero. The team corrected the setting and resent invitations with new links.

email-service.title: Email-service cannot establish a secure connection to the mail relay
email-service.description: Outbound employee notifications remained queued instead of reaching recipients. Delivery monitoring showed repeated secure connection failures.
email-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the mail relay had expired. The certificate was renewed and queued messages were delivered.

email-service.title: Leave approval emails are delayed during a mail provider outage
email-service.description: Managers received leave approval requests hours after employees submitted them. The email-service delivery dashboard showed that the external mail provider was unavailable.
email-service.resolution_summary: The mail provider experienced an outage and rejected delivery attempts. The email-service retried the queued messages after the provider recovered.

email-service.title: Bulk schedule change emails exhaust email-service memory
email-service.description: Employees did not receive schedule change notices promptly after a large roster update. Memory alerts and repeated worker restarts revealed that the email-service was struggling to process the batch.
email-service.resolution_summary: The batch handler loaded all recipients into memory at once. The team changed it to process recipients in smaller pages and replayed the pending batch.

email-service.title: Delivery history pages time out for tenants with many messages
email-service.description: Administrators could not load email delivery history for tenants with large message volumes. The issue was detected when page timeout alerts increased.
email-service.resolution_summary: A delivery history query scanned the message table without a suitable index. Adding an index and revising the query restored normal response times.

email-service.title: Corrupted preference records suppress mandatory payroll emails
email-service.description: Some employees did not receive mandatory payroll notices even though the notices should not have been optional. A reconciliation check found fewer delivered notices than expected.
email-service.resolution_summary: A migration corrupted notification preference records, causing mandatory notices to be treated as optional. The team repaired the affected records and resent the notices.

email-service.title: Email-service cannot resolve the outbound mail relay
email-service.description: Employee emails accumulated in the delivery queue without being sent. Queue age alerts and name resolution errors exposed the problem.
email-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record pointed the relay name to a nonexistent host. The team corrected the record and drained the queue.

email-service.title: Email-service loses access to stored message attachments
email-service.description: Payroll administrators received emails without the requested payroll export attachments. Support reports and attachment retrieval errors identified the issue.
email-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the email-service's read access to attachment storage. Access was restored and the affected exports were resent.

email-service.title: Bounce events stop updating after a provider API change
email-service.description: Administrators saw delivered status for some emails that had actually bounced. A comparison of provider reports and email-service records exposed the mismatch.
email-service.resolution_summary: The mail provider changed the bounce event payload, and the parser ignored the new format. The parser was updated and available bounce events were replayed.

email-service.title: Scheduled timesheet reminder job does not run
email-service.description: Employees did not receive reminders to submit incomplete timesheets. Operations detected the gap when the expected reminder count remained at zero.
email-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job was disabled during a scheduler configuration update. The team re-enabled it and sent the missed reminders.

email-service.title: Duplicate shift swap emails are sent after queue retries
email-service.description: Managers received multiple emails for the same shift swap request. Support tickets and duplicate message records showed that retries were creating extra notifications.
email-service.resolution_summary: The email-service failed to record an idempotency key before retrying a delivery task. The team fixed the retry handling and removed duplicate tasks from the queue.

email-service.title: Offer letter emails show the wrong tenant branding
email-service.description: Some candidates received offer letter emails with another tenant's logo and colors. A customer report led the team to inspect rendered message previews.
email-service.resolution_summary: The template cache used a shared key that omitted the tenant identifier. The team corrected the cache key and cleared the affected entries.

email-service.title: Large payroll export attachments are rejected before delivery
email-service.description: Administrators did not receive payroll export emails when the attached file exceeded the email-service limit. Application logs showed that attachment validation was rejecting the messages.
email-service.resolution_summary: The configured attachment limit was lower than the supported export size. The team raised the limit within the mail provider's allowance and requeued the rejected emails.

email-service.title: Unsubscribe links fail in optional company announcement emails
email-service.description: Employees who selected the unsubscribe link received an error and continued to receive optional announcements. Support reports and link error alerts revealed the issue.
email-service.resolution_summary: The link signer and verifier used different signing key versions after a key rotation. The team synchronized the key versions and restored unsubscribe processing.

email-service.title: Email-service rejects valid international recipient addresses
email-service.description: Some employees with international characters in their addresses did not receive onboarding emails. Delivery failure reports showed that the addresses were rejected before submission to the mail provider.
email-service.resolution_summary: A validation rule incorrectly allowed only basic ASCII characters in recipient addresses. The team updated the validator to handle supported international addresses and retried the messages.

email-service.title: Email-service sends time-sensitive reminders after their deadline
email-service.description: Employees received timesheet reminders after the submission deadline had passed. Monitoring showed an increasing backlog of reminder tasks.
email-service.resolution_summary: Reminder workers were assigned too few concurrent slots after a capacity adjustment. The team increased worker concurrency and discarded reminders that were no longer useful.

email-service.title: Password reset emails contain broken reset buttons
email-service.description: Users received password reset emails but the reset button did not open the intended page. Support reports and an automated link check identified the broken buttons.
email-service.resolution_summary: A template escaping change encoded part of the reset link twice. The team corrected the escaping logic and issued replacement reset emails.

email-service.title: Suppression list incorrectly blocks new employee invitations
email-service.description: Some new hires did not receive account invitations despite having valid recipient addresses. Administrators noticed the failures in the email-service delivery history.
email-service.resolution_summary: A suppression import matched recipients using only the domain portion of their address. The team corrected the matching logic, removed the incorrect entries, and resent invitations.

email-service.title: Delivery webhooks are rejected after a network policy change
email-service.description: Administrators saw pending delivery status for emails that had already reached recipients. An alert showed that incoming delivery webhooks were being rejected.
email-service.resolution_summary: A network policy change blocked the mail provider's webhook traffic. The team restored the required access and reconciled message statuses with provider records.

search-service.title: Employee searches return no matches after a release
search-service.description: Users searching for employees by name saw empty results even when the employees existed. Support reports and a drop in successful searches exposed the problem.
search-service.resolution_summary: A deployment changed the query analyzer without updating the index analyzer. The release was rolled back and the analyzers were aligned before redeployment.

search-service.title: Search results stop after the first 25 employees
search-service.description: Managers could not see employees beyond the first page of search results. The issue was detected when support compared result counts with directory totals.
search-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the maximum result window to 25. Restoring the intended limit allowed users to page through all authorized results.

search-service.title: Search requests fail because the index certificate expired
search-service.description: Users received search errors across employee and payroll document searches. Connection alerts showed that search-service could no longer establish a trusted connection to its index.
search-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the index endpoint had expired. The certificate was renewed and the search-service connections were refreshed.

search-service.title: Employee search fails during identity service outage
search-service.description: Users could open the application but received errors when searching for employees. Search-service dependency alerts identified failures while retrieving user access scopes.
search-service.resolution_summary: An identity service outage prevented search-service from checking which records users could see. Search recovered when the dependency was restored, and cached scopes were made available for brief interruptions.

search-service.title: Large searches cause search-service to run out of memory
search-service.description: Broad searches over workforce records intermittently failed or returned slowly. Memory alerts and repeated process restarts revealed the issue.
search-service.resolution_summary: A query path loaded entire result sets into memory before applying pagination. The path was changed to fetch only the requested page.

search-service.title: Payroll document searches time out for large tenants
search-service.description: Users in large tenants saw payroll document searches spin until they timed out. Query latency alerts showed that the search-service database lookup was taking unusually long.
search-service.resolution_summary: A missing database index forced a scan of payroll document metadata. Adding the index reduced lookup time and cleared the timeouts.

search-service.title: Some employee profiles disappear from search results
search-service.description: Users could open affected employee profiles directly but could not find them through search. A reconciliation check detected a mismatch between source records and indexed records.
search-service.resolution_summary: A malformed indexing batch overwrote search document identifiers for a subset of employees. The affected documents were removed and rebuilt from the source records.

search-service.title: Search-service cannot resolve the index endpoint
search-service.description: Employee and job searches returned connection errors. Service health checks detected repeated DNS resolution failures for the search index.
search-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record prevented search-service from locating the index endpoint. Correcting the record and clearing cached lookups restored connectivity.

search-service.title: New payroll documents are missing from search
search-service.description: Users could view newly generated payroll documents but could not find them through search. Indexing alerts showed repeated permission errors when search-service read document metadata.
search-service.resolution_summary: A permission change removed the search indexer's access to the metadata store. Restoring the required read permission allowed the backlog to be indexed.

search-service.title: Location searches fail after a geocoding API change
search-service.description: Users searching for open shifts near a location saw errors instead of results. Integration monitoring detected rejected requests to the geocoding provider.
search-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed a required request parameter, and search-service was still sending the old format. Updating the integration to use the new parameter restored location searches.

search-service.title: Former employees remain visible in directory searches
search-service.description: Managers continued to find former employees in searches that should have excluded them. A routine comparison of search results with employee status records detected the mismatch.
search-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job that applies employee status changes had stopped after encountering an invalid record. The record was corrected, the job was rerun, and error handling was improved.

search-service.title: Recently created job postings are delayed in search
search-service.description: Recruiters could save job postings but had to wait before finding them in search. Queue monitoring showed a growing backlog of indexing events.
search-service.resolution_summary: Indexing consumers were processing events more slowly than they arrived after a burst of updates. Additional consumers were started and batch processing was tuned to clear the backlog.

search-service.title: Search indexing stops when a shard runs out of disk space
search-service.description: Existing employee searches worked, but profile changes did not appear in results. Index health alerts showed that one shard had stopped accepting writes.
search-service.resolution_summary: The shard exhausted its available disk space because obsolete index segments had accumulated. Removing unused segments and expanding storage restored indexing.

search-service.title: Search fails to match employee names with accented characters
search-service.description: Users could not find some employees when typing names with or without accents. Support reproduced the issue using affected names and compared the stored search tokens.
search-service.resolution_summary: The name tokenizer handled accented characters differently at indexing and query time. Consistent character normalization was applied and the affected names were reindexed.

search-service.title: Search results include employees outside a manager's access
search-service.description: Some managers saw employee records outside their assigned teams in search results. An access audit detected results that did not match current reporting permissions.
search-service.resolution_summary: Search-service retained outdated team membership in its authorization cache after transfers. The cache was invalidated on membership changes and affected entries were cleared.

search-service.title: Search pagination repeats results and skips employees
search-service.description: Users paging through employee results saw duplicates and missed some records. Support reproduced the problem when several employees shared the same display name.
search-service.resolution_summary: The pagination cursor used a non-unique sort field. Adding a unique secondary sort key made page boundaries consistent.

search-service.title: Benefits searches return unrelated policy documents
search-service.description: Users searching for benefit policies received irrelevant documents near the top of the results. Search quality checks detected a sudden drop in relevance for common benefit terms.
search-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect synonym rule treated unrelated policy terms as equivalents. Removing the rule and refreshing the search configuration restored relevance.

search-service.title: Large search responses fail between search-service and its index
search-service.description: Users received intermittent errors on searches with many matching workforce records, while narrow searches continued to work. Network monitoring showed dropped packets on the path to the index.
search-service.resolution_summary: A network configuration mismatch dropped packets above the supported size. Aligning the path MTU settings restored large responses.

search-service.title: Workforce searches omit records after a schema update
search-service.description: Users could not find some shifts by department even though the shifts appeared in schedules. Indexing validation alerts showed that department values were being rejected.
search-service.resolution_summary: The shift schema changed the department field format, but search-service still expected the previous format. The mapper was updated and rejected records were reprocessed.

search-service.title: Search requests are rejected during a burst of directory use
search-service.description: Users intermittently received rate-limit errors when many managers searched the employee directory at once. Request metrics showed that search-service was exceeding the index gateway's request quota.
search-service.resolution_summary: A client retry loop amplified the initial burst by immediately retrying rejected requests. Exponential backoff and a concurrency limit reduced the request rate and stopped the errors.

reporting-service.title: Payroll reports fail after a report builder update
reporting-service.description: Users saw an error when running payroll reports with department filters. Other report types continued to work. Support detected the issue after several customers reported the same failure.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an invalid filter parameter for payroll queries. The change was rolled back and the parameter handling was corrected.

reporting-service.title: Large workforce reports time out before completing
reporting-service.description: Users running workforce reports for large tenants received timeout errors. Smaller reports completed normally. The reporting-service error dashboard showed a sharp increase in timed-out requests.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change reduced the report execution timeout below the time needed for large queries. The timeout was restored to its previous value.

reporting-service.title: Scheduled report delivery fails because of an expired certificate
reporting-service.description: Users stopped receiving scheduled reports even though their schedules remained active. Delivery failures appeared in reporting-service monitoring and were confirmed by customer reports.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate report delivery requests had expired. The certificate was renewed and failed deliveries were retried.

reporting-service.title: Report downloads fail during storage service outage
reporting-service.description: Users could generate reports but received errors when downloading the completed files. Reporting-service alerts showed repeated failures when retrieving files from the storage dependency.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The storage dependency was temporarily unavailable. Downloads recovered when the dependency was restored, and affected reports were regenerated.

reporting-service.title: Large payroll exports restart reporting workers
reporting-service.description: Large payroll exports stopped midway and returned a generic error. Smaller exports were unaffected. Monitoring showed reporting-service workers restarting during the largest export requests.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The export worker loaded entire result sets into memory before writing files. Exports were changed to stream rows in batches, reducing memory use.

reporting-service.title: Headcount reports load slowly after employee records grow
reporting-service.description: Headcount reports took several minutes to load for tenants with many employee records. Users reported slow dashboards, and query monitoring showed long database execution times.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A missing index forced the headcount query to scan a large employee table. Adding the index and updating the query restored normal response times.

reporting-service.title: Turnover reports show duplicate employee departures
reporting-service.description: Some turnover reports counted the same departure more than once. HR users noticed that report totals did not match their employee records.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: Duplicate departure events had been written to the reporting dataset during a failed retry. The duplicate rows were removed and the ingestion process was updated to reject repeat events.

reporting-service.title: Reporting-service cannot resolve the payroll data endpoint
reporting-service.description: Payroll reports failed to load because reporting-service could not reach its payroll data dependency. Network alerts identified repeated name resolution failures.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change pointed requests to an invalid resolver. Restoring the resolver configuration allowed payroll data requests to succeed.

reporting-service.title: Managers cannot open reports shared with their teams
reporting-service.description: Managers received access denied errors when opening reports that had been shared with them. Tenant administrators confirmed that the reports were still shared, then contacted support.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A permissions mapping change omitted the manager role from shared report access checks. The mapping was corrected and access was restored.

reporting-service.title: Benefits reports omit plan names from external enrollment data
reporting-service.description: Benefits reports displayed blank plan names while enrollment counts remained visible. A customer noticed the missing names and support reproduced the issue in reporting-service.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: An external enrollment API renamed the field containing the plan name. The reporting-service integration was updated to read the new field.

reporting-service.title: Overtime dashboards show stale totals after refresh job fails
reporting-service.description: Overtime dashboards continued to show old totals after new shifts were recorded. A freshness alert showed that the reporting-service aggregation job had not completed.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job failed on an unexpected null value in a shift record. The job was fixed to handle the value and the missed aggregation was rerun.

reporting-service.title: Scheduled reports arrive hours late when the queue backs up
reporting-service.description: Users received scheduled reports much later than expected. Queue monitoring showed that report generation requests were accumulating faster than workers processed them.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: Too few workers were assigned to the scheduled report queue after a capacity change. Worker capacity was increased and the backlog was processed.

reporting-service.title: Attendance reports place overnight shifts on the wrong day
reporting-service.description: Attendance reports assigned some overnight shifts to the following day. Managers found discrepancies while comparing reports with shift records.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: Reporting-service grouped shift start times using UTC instead of the tenant's configured time zone. The grouping logic was corrected and affected report data was rebuilt.

reporting-service.title: Custom reports fail after a payroll field type changes
reporting-service.description: Custom reports containing a payroll adjustment field failed to run. An increase in report execution errors led support to identify the affected field.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The upstream field changed from an integer to a decimal, but reporting-service still parsed it as an integer. The parser and report schema were updated to accept decimal values.

reporting-service.title: Saved report changes do not appear when reports are reopened
reporting-service.description: Users saved changes to report columns but saw the previous columns when reopening the report. Support reproduced the issue after multiple users reported losing their changes.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The report definition cache was not invalidated after updates. Cache invalidation was fixed and stale entries were cleared.

reporting-service.title: Report creation button disappears for eligible users
reporting-service.description: Eligible users could view existing reports but could not create new ones. Support detected the issue after administrators reported the missing button.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A feature flag configuration accidentally disabled report creation for eligible tenants. The flag targeting was corrected.

reporting-service.title: Employee profile reports fail when directory requests are throttled
reporting-service.description: Some employee profile reports failed while fetching employee attributes. Reporting-service logs showed that the directory dependency was rejecting bursts of requests.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The report generator sent requests above the dependency's rate limit. Request batching and retry delays were added to keep traffic within the limit.

reporting-service.title: CSV report exports fail when temporary disk space fills
reporting-service.description: Users received export errors after reports had finished querying data. An alert showed that reporting-service workers had exhausted temporary disk space.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: Temporary export files were not removed after successful downloads. The cleanup process was repaired and existing temporary files were deleted.

reporting-service.title: Concurrent report edits leave saves waiting indefinitely
reporting-service.description: Users editing popular shared reports saw save requests spin without completing. Database monitoring showed blocked transactions associated with report definition updates.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: Two update paths acquired database locks in different orders, causing deadlocks. The update paths were changed to acquire locks consistently.

reporting-service.title: Payroll summary totals are rounded incorrectly in PDF reports
reporting-service.description: PDF payroll summaries showed totals that differed slightly from the corresponding CSV exports. A payroll administrator noticed the discrepancy during reconciliation.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The PDF renderer rounded each row before calculating the total. It was changed to sum the unrounded values and round only the final total.

data-pipeline.title: Overtime hours missing from payroll exports
data-pipeline.description: Payroll exports generated by data-pipeline omitted overtime hours for employees with multiple time entries. Payroll administrators noticed that export totals did not match approved timesheets.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the aggregation logic to keep only the first time entry per employee. The change was rolled back and affected exports were regenerated.

data-pipeline.title: Employee updates stop after certificate expiration
data-pipeline.description: New hires and employee changes stopped appearing in downstream workforce reports. Data-pipeline alerted on repeated connection failures to its event source.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The certificate used to connect to the event source had expired. It was renewed, and queued employee updates were replayed.

data-pipeline.title: Payroll export files delayed by storage outage
data-pipeline.description: Payroll administrators could not download newly requested export files because data-pipeline could not write them to object storage. The support team confirmed the issue after a storage availability alert.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The object storage dependency was unavailable. Data-pipeline retried the pending writes after storage recovered, and the delayed exports became available.

data-pipeline.title: Large tenant imports fail during employee reconciliation
data-pipeline.description: Employee imports for large tenants stopped partway through reconciliation, leaving some records unchanged. Operators detected repeated worker restarts while investigating customer reports.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The reconciliation worker loaded the full employee list into memory and exhausted its allocation. Processing was changed to use bounded batches, and failed imports were rerun.

data-pipeline.title: Workforce reports lag behind approved timesheets
data-pipeline.description: Workforce reports showed stale hours even though timesheets had been approved. Data-pipeline's freshness monitor reported an increasing delay.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A database query scanning approved timesheets lacked an index for its filter. Adding the index reduced query time and allowed the pipeline to clear the backlog.

data-pipeline.title: Accented employee names become garbled in exports
data-pipeline.description: Some employee names appeared with replacement characters in payroll exports generated by data-pipeline. A payroll administrator reported the mismatch after comparing an export with employee profiles.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: An import step decoded source files using the wrong character encoding and stored corrupted names. The decoder was corrected and affected records were reimported from the original files.

data-pipeline.title: Time entries arrive late after event broker DNS failures
data-pipeline.description: Approved time entries took much longer than usual to appear in payroll previews. Connection error alerts showed that data-pipeline workers could not resolve the event broker hostname.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the broker's required address record. The record was restored and workers consumed the queued events.

data-pipeline.title: Department changes fail to load into reporting tables
data-pipeline.description: Department changes were visible in employee profiles but absent from workforce reports. Data-pipeline's load failure alert identified repeated permission errors.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A role change removed write access to the department reporting table. The required permission was restored and failed changes were replayed.

data-pipeline.title: Benefits deductions missing from some payroll feeds
data-pipeline.description: Some payroll feeds lacked benefits deduction records even though the deductions appeared in the benefits system. Reconciliation checks detected a lower record count than expected.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A third-party API changed its pagination response, causing data-pipeline to stop after the first page. The connector was updated and the missing deduction records were fetched.

data-pipeline.title: Scheduled payroll export preparation does not start
data-pipeline.description: Payroll administrators saw exports remain in a pending state rather than becoming ready for review. An alert showed that the scheduled data-pipeline preparation job had not run.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The job scheduler had a disabled trigger after a configuration update. The trigger was restored and the missed preparation jobs were run.

data-pipeline.title: New employee records rejected after source schema change
data-pipeline.description: Some newly created employees did not appear in downstream reports. Data-pipeline's validation alert showed a rise in rejected employee events.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The source added an optional field that the pipeline's strict schema did not recognize. The schema was updated and rejected events were reprocessed.

data-pipeline.title: Duplicate shift records inflate workforce reports
data-pipeline.description: Managers saw duplicate shifts and inflated scheduled hours in workforce reports. A reconciliation check found more report rows than source shift records.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A retry path inserted shift records without checking whether they had already been processed. Idempotent writes were added and duplicate report rows were removed.

data-pipeline.title: Older employee updates overwrite newer profile data
data-pipeline.description: Some downstream reports showed outdated job titles after employees had already been transferred. The discrepancy was detected through a support investigation comparing source and report histories.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: Data-pipeline applied employee events in arrival order rather than source update order. Version checks were added and affected profiles were rebuilt from source records.

data-pipeline.title: Leave balances lag as pipeline queue fills
data-pipeline.description: Leave balance changes took longer than usual to appear in workforce reports. Queue monitoring detected a growing backlog in data-pipeline.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A burst of leave events exceeded the configured consumer throughput. Additional consumers were started and the backlog cleared.

data-pipeline.title: Payroll deduction amounts lose cents in exports
data-pipeline.description: Some deduction amounts in payroll exports were rounded to whole currency units. Payroll administrators detected the mismatch while reviewing export totals.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A transformation cast decimal deduction amounts to integers. The decimal type was restored and affected exports were regenerated.

data-pipeline.title: Overnight shifts assigned to the wrong workday
data-pipeline.description: Managers saw some overnight shifts attributed to the wrong workday in data-pipeline reports. A customer report led support to compare shift times with the tenant's configured time zone.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A configuration change made the pipeline group shifts using a fixed time zone instead of each tenant's time zone. The setting was corrected and affected report data was rebuilt.

data-pipeline.title: Corrected timesheets remain absent from payroll previews
data-pipeline.description: Corrections to previously approved timesheets did not appear in payroll previews. Data-pipeline alerted that records were accumulating in its dead-letter queue.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The correction handler rejected valid events that lacked an optional comment. The validation rule was fixed and the queued corrections were replayed.

data-pipeline.title: Employee changes lost after database stream interruption
data-pipeline.description: Some employee updates remained missing from reports after a database connection interruption. A reconciliation job detected differences between source records and data-pipeline output.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The change stream's retained history expired before the pipeline resumed from its saved position. A fresh snapshot restored the missing changes, and retention was increased.

data-pipeline.title: Workforce import stalls on third-party rate limits
data-pipeline.description: Workforce imports from an external scheduling system remained incomplete, delaying updated shift reports. Data-pipeline alerts showed repeated rate-limit responses from the external API.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The connector sent requests faster than the provider allowed. Request pacing and backoff were added, and incomplete imports were resumed.

data-pipeline.title: Payroll exports contain records from the wrong pay period
data-pipeline.description: Some payroll exports included time entries outside the selected pay period. A payroll administrator identified the extra entries during export review.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The pay-period filter treated the end boundary as inclusive when it should have been exclusive. The filter was corrected and affected exports were regenerated.

message-queue.title: Payroll export messages disappear before processing
