message-queue.description: Some payroll exports never reached the payroll processor, leaving users waiting for files. Operators detected a mismatch between accepted messages and completed exports.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A deployment acknowledged messages before they were durably stored. The change was rolled back and recoverable exports were resubmitted.

message-queue.title: Shift change notifications expire while waiting in the queue
message-queue.description: Employees did not receive some shift change notifications during a period of high traffic. A drop in delivered notifications and a rise in expired messages exposed the problem.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the message time-to-live too low. The limit was corrected and affected notifications were requeued where still relevant.

message-queue.title: Queue consumers cannot connect after certificate expiry
message-queue.description: Payroll and workforce updates stopped processing because consumers could not establish secure connections to message-queue. Connection failure alerts identified an expired certificate.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The broker's service certificate expired without being renewed. Operators installed a valid certificate and restarted the affected connections.

message-queue.title: Broker outage delays employee profile updates
message-queue.description: Employee profile changes took longer than usual to appear in downstream applications. Queue health checks showed that the broker dependency was unavailable.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The broker failed during storage recovery and stopped accepting messages. Operators restored the broker and drained the accumulated backlog.

message-queue.title: Message-queue restarts repeatedly under high memory load
message-queue.description: Bulk employee imports processed intermittently and took much longer than expected. Restart alerts and memory graphs showed that message-queue was exhausting its available memory.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The service buffered too many large messages in memory at once. Operators reduced the buffer limit and added capacity before resuming normal traffic.

message-queue.title: Slow message status query delays payroll job updates
message-queue.description: Users saw payroll jobs remain in a pending state after processing had started. Database latency alerts traced the delay to message-queue's status lookup.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A status query scanned a large table because it lacked a suitable index. Adding the index restored normal update times.

message-queue.title: Corrupted queue records prevent benefit enrollment messages from loading
message-queue.description: Some benefit enrollment changes remained pending and did not reach the benefits processor. Operators found repeated read errors for a segment of the queue.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A storage fault corrupted several persisted message records. The damaged segment was isolated and affected changes were reconstructed from the enrollment audit log.

message-queue.title: DNS failures prevent message-queue from reaching its broker
message-queue.description: New time-off requests were saved but their downstream updates were delayed. Connection alerts showed that message-queue could not resolve the broker hostname.
message-queue.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record pointed broker lookups to an invalid address. The record was corrected and queued updates were processed.

message-queue.title: Permission change blocks publishing of payslip notifications
message-queue.description: Users did not receive notifications when new payslips became available. Publishing errors in message-queue revealed that the service no longer had access to the notification topic.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A permissions update removed the publisher role from the service account. Restoring the role allowed pending notifications to be sent.

message-queue.title: Notification queue backs up after provider API response change
message-queue.description: Payroll-ready notifications were delayed even though payroll runs completed. Retry alerts showed that message-queue was rejecting successful responses from the notification provider.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The provider changed its success response format, which the queue's delivery adapter did not recognize. The adapter was updated and the backlog was retried.

message-queue.title: Scheduled queue cleanup stops after checkpoint failure
message-queue.description: Older completed message records accumulated and slowed queue administration pages. A storage growth alert led operators to the failed cleanup job.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The scheduled cleanup job could not read its saved checkpoint after the checkpoint record was damaged. Operators repaired the checkpoint and reran the cleanup.

message-queue.title: Malformed shift event blocks a message partition
message-queue.description: Shift updates for some employees stopped appearing in downstream schedules. Backlog monitoring showed that one partition was making no progress.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A malformed shift event caused the consumer to fail repeatedly without advancing past it. The event was moved to the dead-letter queue and validation was added.

message-queue.title: Short visibility timeout causes duplicate timesheet processing
message-queue.description: Some timesheet updates were processed more than once, producing duplicate activity entries. A spike in redelivery counts revealed the issue.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The visibility timeout was shorter than the processing time for large timesheets. Operators increased the timeout and added safeguards against duplicate processing.

message-queue.title: Uneven partition traffic delays large tenant imports
message-queue.description: Large employee imports were delayed while smaller imports continued normally. Per-partition metrics showed that one queue partition had a much larger backlog than the others.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The partition key concentrated a large tenant's messages on one partition. The routing strategy was changed to spread import work more evenly.

message-queue.title: Queue consumers reject updated employee event schema
message-queue.description: Employee changes were saved but did not appear in downstream payroll records. Consumer error rates rose after a new event format was introduced.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A producer added a required field that older consumers could not handle. The schema change was made backward compatible and failed events were replayed.

message-queue.title: Queue writes fail when broker disk fills
message-queue.description: Some workforce updates could not be queued, and users were prompted to retry. Disk usage and write failure alerts identified a full broker volume.
message-queue.resolution_summary: Retained queue segments consumed the remaining disk space. Operators removed eligible old segments and adjusted retention limits.

message-queue.title: Large queue messages fail across a network link
message-queue.description: Small employee updates processed normally, but large bulk updates repeatedly failed. Network traces showed connections resetting during transfers of larger messages.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A network path had an inconsistent packet size limit that disrupted large transfers. Correcting the network configuration restored delivery.

message-queue.title: Aggressive retries overwhelm the notification delivery queue
message-queue.description: Notification delivery slowed across multiple workflows, including leave approvals and schedule changes. Queue metrics showed a sharp rise in retry traffic following a brief provider disruption.
message-queue.resolution_summary: Retries had no effective backoff, causing failed deliveries to flood the queue. Operators enabled exponential backoff and processed the backlog.

message-queue.title: Broker leader election stalls message delivery
message-queue.description: Messages accepted for some payroll workflows remained queued without being delivered. Broker monitoring showed that affected partitions had no elected leader.
message-queue.resolution_summary: An inconsistent quorum configuration prevented the remaining brokers from electing leaders. Operators corrected the configuration and restored partition leadership.

message-queue.title: Rotated encryption key leaves queued messages unreadable
message-queue.description: Some queued employee document events could not be processed after a key rotation. Decryption errors in message-queue identified the affected messages.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The previous decryption key was removed before all messages encrypted with it had been consumed. Operators restored access to the old key and updated the rotation procedure.

file-storage.title: New uploads fail after a file-storage deployment
file-storage.description: Employees could not upload onboarding documents, and the upload screen showed a generic error. The support team reported the failures after upload error alerts increased.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an incorrect request validation rule. Rolling back the change restored uploads.

file-storage.title: Payroll attachments above the size limit are rejected
file-storage.description: Payroll administrators could not attach larger supporting files to payroll records. Support noticed a pattern of rejected uploads reported by multiple tenants.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A configuration change lowered the upload size limit below the documented value. Restoring the intended limit fixed the failures.

file-storage.title: Document downloads fail certificate verification
file-storage.description: Employees received connection errors when downloading stored documents. A certificate monitoring alert detected the failures before support reports arrived.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the file download endpoint had expired. Renewing and installing it restored downloads.

file-storage.title: Stored files temporarily unavailable during object storage outage
file-storage.description: Users could see document names but could not open or download the files. Availability alerts and support reports showed failures across multiple tenants.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The underlying object storage provider was unavailable. Downloads recovered when the provider restored service and file-storage retried failed requests.

file-storage.title: Large document previews exhaust file-storage memory
file-storage.description: Previews of large employee documents failed, and some unrelated preview requests also timed out. Memory alerts identified repeated restarts of the preview workers.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The preview process loaded entire large files into memory. Processing files in smaller chunks stopped the restarts.

file-storage.title: File search takes too long for tenants with many documents
file-storage.description: HR administrators saw long waits when searching employee attachments, and some searches timed out. Database latency monitoring highlighted the affected requests.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A search query scanned the full file metadata table because it lacked an appropriate index. Adding the index reduced query time.

file-storage.title: Multipart uploads produce files with invalid checksums
file-storage.description: Some large uploaded documents could not be opened after upload completed. Integrity checks detected checksum mismatches and alerted the operations team.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A multipart upload handler assembled parts in the wrong order when retries occurred. The handler was corrected, and affected files were reuploaded where source copies were available.

file-storage.title: File-storage cannot resolve the object storage endpoint
file-storage.description: Uploads and downloads failed intermittently even though users could still browse file lists. Network monitoring showed repeated name resolution failures.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed a required resolver entry. Restoring the entry allowed file-storage to reach object storage again.

file-storage.title: Managers cannot download documents they are allowed to view
file-storage.description: Managers saw permission errors when opening employee documents within their assigned teams. Support reproduced the issue using accounts with the affected role.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A permissions update omitted the download action from the manager role. Restoring that permission fixed access without changing visibility rules.

file-storage.title: Document virus scans stop after scanner API response change
file-storage.description: New uploads remained in a pending state and could not be opened by users. Queue monitoring showed that scan results were no longer being processed.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The external scanning service changed a response field that file-storage expected. Updating the response parser allowed queued files to finish scanning.

file-storage.title: Deleted employee files remain listed after cleanup
file-storage.description: Administrators continued to see deleted document entries in file lists, although the files could not be opened. A reconciliation alert found a growing number of orphaned metadata records.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The scheduled metadata cleanup job had stopped after encountering an unhandled error. Fixing the error and rerunning the job removed the stale entries.

file-storage.title: Uploaded files stay pending while scan queue grows
file-storage.description: Employees could upload documents, but the files remained unavailable for viewing. Queue age alerts showed that scanning workers were falling behind.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The worker pool had too few consumers for the upload volume. Increasing worker capacity cleared the backlog.

file-storage.title: Archived employee documents disappear from storage
file-storage.description: HR administrators could see archived document records but received missing file errors when opening them. A storage reconciliation check detected the missing objects.
file-storage.resolution_summary: An incorrect storage lifecycle rule deleted archived objects too early. The rule was corrected, and recoverable files were restored from backups.

file-storage.title: Encrypted documents fail to open after key rotation
file-storage.description: Some previously uploaded documents returned decryption errors when users tried to download them. Error monitoring identified failures concentrated on older files.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The rotation process removed access to a key version still needed by stored files. Restoring that key version and correcting the rotation process fixed access.

file-storage.title: Concurrent document edits overwrite a newer file version
file-storage.description: Users found that an older document revision sometimes replaced a newer one. Support identified the pattern after reviewing reports of missing edits.
file-storage.resolution_summary: Version updates were not checked for concurrent changes before saving. Adding a version check prevented stale updates from overwriting newer files.

file-storage.title: Document previews show stale content after file replacement
file-storage.description: Users who replaced an employee document sometimes saw the previous version in the preview. Support reproduced the mismatch between the preview and downloaded file.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The preview cache was not invalidated when a file was replaced. Invalidating cached previews on replacement restored consistency.

file-storage.title: Download links expire immediately after creation
file-storage.description: Employees received expired-link errors when opening newly generated document links. Monitoring showed an increase in link validation failures.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A file-storage host had an incorrect system clock, causing it to generate links with past expiry times. Restoring clock synchronization fixed new links.

file-storage.title: Uploads fail when temporary file space fills up
file-storage.description: Users saw upload errors for documents of all sizes. Disk usage alerts showed that temporary storage on upload workers was full.
file-storage.resolution_summary: Failed uploads left temporary files behind until the disk filled. Removing the abandoned files and fixing cleanup restored uploads.

file-storage.title: File access audit records appear more than once
file-storage.description: Administrators reviewing document access saw duplicate entries for some downloads. An audit reconciliation check detected more access records than completed download requests.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A message retry caused the audit consumer to write the same event more than once. Adding duplicate detection and removing duplicate records corrected the log.

file-storage.title: Storage quota remains full after users delete files
file-storage.description: Users could not upload new documents even after deleting enough files to free space. Support found that affected tenants still showed their previous storage usage.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The usage counter was not updated when file deletion completed. Recalculating usage and fixing the deletion handler restored accurate quotas.

web-frontend.title: Payroll dashboard stays blank after sign-in
web-frontend.description: Users reached a blank page when opening the payroll dashboard in web-frontend. They could not review pay runs, and the support team detected the problem through reports from multiple tenants.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A deploy introduced a JavaScript error in the dashboard initialization code. Rolling back the deploy and correcting the initialization order restored the page.

web-frontend.title: Employee profiles fail to load after a configuration change
web-frontend.description: Employee profile pages showed a loading spinner indefinitely in web-frontend. A rise in failed browser requests alerted the on-call team before users reported that they could not review employee details.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed profile requests to the wrong API path. Restoring the correct path fixed profile loading.

web-frontend.title: Browsers reject the web-frontend connection
web-frontend.description: Users saw a certificate warning instead of the sign-in page. Synthetic browser checks detected the failure, which prevented users from accessing the application.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the web-frontend endpoint had expired. Renewing and deploying the certificate restored secure connections.

web-frontend.title: Timesheet pages show errors during an API outage
web-frontend.description: Users opening timesheets in web-frontend saw an error banner instead of their hours. Support reports and a drop in successful timesheet loads revealed the issue.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The timesheet API was unavailable, and web-frontend could not retrieve entries. The API was restored, and the frontend error message was updated to explain that users should retry.

web-frontend.title: Large employee directories freeze the browser tab
web-frontend.description: Users at large tenants found that the employee directory became unresponsive while loading. Browser performance reports and support tickets showed that users could not search or select employees.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The directory rendered every employee row at once, exhausting browser memory for large lists. Rendering only the visible rows reduced memory use and restored responsiveness.

web-frontend.title: Payroll history takes too long to open
web-frontend.description: The payroll history screen in web-frontend frequently timed out for tenants with many pay runs. Request latency alerts and user reports showed that users could not inspect past payroll summaries.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A database query behind the history endpoint scanned too many records. Adding an index and limiting the requested result set brought page load times back down.

web-frontend.title: Saved schedule views fail to open
web-frontend.description: Some managers saw an error when opening saved schedule views in web-frontend. Support identified the issue after affected users reported that they had to rebuild their filters.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A migration wrote malformed filter settings for a subset of saved views. Repairing the affected records and validating settings before saving fixed the issue.

web-frontend.title: Static assets fail to resolve for some users
web-frontend.description: Some users saw an unstyled page or a loading error when accessing web-frontend. Synthetic checks from several locations detected failures to resolve the asset hostname.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed a required asset hostname record. Restoring the record allowed browsers to download the frontend files.

web-frontend.title: Managers cannot open team time-off requests
web-frontend.description: Managers saw an access denied message when opening their team's time-off requests in web-frontend. Support reports revealed that authorized managers could not review or approve requests.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A permission mapping incorrectly treated the team reviewer role as an employee-only role. Correcting the mapping restored access for authorized managers.

web-frontend.title: Address autocomplete stops suggesting locations
web-frontend.description: The address field in web-frontend stopped offering suggestions while users edited employee profiles. The problem was detected through a rise in failed autocomplete requests and reports from users entering addresses manually.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The address provider changed the response format expected by the frontend integration. Updating the response parser restored suggestions.

web-frontend.title: Users receive missing file errors after a frontend release
web-frontend.description: Some users saw a loading error when opening web-frontend after a release. Browser error monitoring showed that the application was requesting files that were no longer available.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A scheduled job failed to publish the asset manifest for the new build. Republishing the manifest and retaining the previous build's files restored access.

web-frontend.title: Sign-in page loops back after successful authentication
web-frontend.description: Users completed authentication but were returned to the web-frontend sign-in page. A spike in repeated login attempts and support reports showed that affected users could not enter the application.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A cookie configuration change prevented the browser from sending the session cookie. Correcting the cookie settings stopped the login loop.

web-frontend.title: Benefits enrollment form rejects valid dependents
web-frontend.description: Users adding dependents to benefits enrollment saw a validation error for valid entries. The issue was detected when support received reports that employees could not finish enrollment.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A frontend validation rule incorrectly required an optional dependent field. Updating the rule to match the enrollment API allowed valid forms to be submitted.

web-frontend.title: Shift calendar shows events at the wrong local time
web-frontend.description: Some users saw shifts displayed one hour away from their scheduled local time in web-frontend. Managers reported the mismatch after comparing the calendar with shift details.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The calendar applied a fixed time-zone offset instead of accounting for daylight saving changes. Using time-zone-aware conversion corrected the displayed shift times.

web-frontend.title: Keyboard users cannot submit expense claims
web-frontend.description: Users navigating web-frontend by keyboard could not reach the submit button on the expense claim form. An accessibility test detected the problem, which prevented affected users from submitting claims without a pointer device.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A modal focus trap remained active after the attachment picker closed. Releasing the trap on close restored keyboard navigation to the submit button.

web-frontend.title: Payroll export downloads an empty file
web-frontend.description: Users requesting a payroll export received an empty download even though the export contained records. Support reproduced the issue after users reported that they could not share payroll data.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A frontend download handler read the response body twice, leaving no data for the file. Reading the body once and passing it to the download handler fixed the export.

web-frontend.title: Leave balances remain stale after an approved request
web-frontend.description: Employees continued to see their old leave balances in web-frontend after requests were approved. Support detected the issue through reports that the balance disagreed with the request history.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend cache was not invalidated when an approval completed. Invalidating the balance cache after approval made the updated value appear.

web-frontend.title: Mobile navigation covers the save button on employee forms
web-frontend.description: Users on narrow screens could not tap the save button on employee forms because it was covered by the navigation bar. Mobile browser testing and support reports revealed that profile edits could not be saved.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A responsive layout change failed to reserve space for the fixed navigation bar. Adding the required bottom spacing made the button accessible.

web-frontend.title: Job applicant attachments fail to open in the browser
web-frontend.description: Recruiters saw a blocked content message when opening applicant attachments from web-frontend. Support detected the issue after reports that resumes could not be reviewed in the application.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A content security policy change blocked the attachment preview source. Allowing the approved preview source in the policy restored attachment viewing.

web-frontend.title: Concurrent users receive errors loading the main dashboard
web-frontend.description: During a traffic surge, users intermittently saw an error instead of the web-frontend dashboard. Request monitoring showed a sharp increase in failed page loads across tenants.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend servers reached their connection limit under concurrent load. Increasing capacity and adjusting connection limits restored reliable dashboard access.
